verses.1:1: The word of God which came upon Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests, who dwelt in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
verses.1:2: to whom the word of God came in the days of Josiah the son of Amos, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.1:3: And it came in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
verses.1:4: And the word of the Lord came to him:
verses.1:5: "Before I fashioned you in the womb I knew you, and before you came forth I sanctified you; I have appointed you a prophet to the nations."
verses.1:6: And I said, "O You who are, Sovereign Lord, behold, I do not know how to speak, for I am too young."
verses.1:7: And the Lord said to me, "Do not say, 'I am too young,' for to all to whom I shall send you, you shall go, and according to all things that I shall command you, you shall speak.
verses.1:8: Do not be afraid before their face, for I am with you to deliver you," says the Lord.
verses.1:9: Then the Lord stretched forth His hand to me and touched my mouth; and the Lord said to me, "Behold, I have put My words into your mouth.
verses.1:10: Behold, I have appointed you this day over nations and kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down and to destroy, and to rebuild and to plant."
verses.1:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "A rod of a nut tree."
verses.1:12: And the Lord said to me, "You have seen well, for I am watchful over My words to perform them."
verses.1:13: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "A cauldron kindled from beneath, and its face is from the face of the north."
verses.1:14: Then the Lord said to me, "From the face of the north evils shall be kindled upon all who dwell in the land.
verses.1:15: For behold, I am summoning all the kingdoms from the north of the earth," says the Lord, "and they shall come, and each one shall set his throne at the entrances of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls around her, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.1:16: And I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their wickedness, how they have forsaken Me and sacrificed to strange gods and worshiped the works of their own hands.
verses.1:17: And you, gird your loins and arise, and speak all things that I shall command you; do not be afraid before their face, nor be dismayed before them, for I am with you to deliver you," says the Lord.
verses.1:18: "Behold, I have set you this day as a fortified city and as a bronze wall, strong against all the kings of Judah, and against its rulers, and against the people of the land;
verses.1:19: and they shall fight against you, yet they shall by no means prevail against you, for I am with you to deliver you," said the Lord.
verses.2:2: And He said, "Thus says the Lord: 'I have remembered the mercy of your youth and the love of its perfection, that you followed after the Holy One of Israel,' says the Lord.
verses.2:3: 'Israel is holy to the Lord, the firstfruits of His produce; all who devour him shall trespass; evils shall come upon them,' says the Lord."
verses.2:4: Hear the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and every family of the house of Israel.
verses.2:5: Thus says the Lord: "What offense did your fathers find in Me, that they departed far from Me, and walked after vain things and became vain?
verses.2:6: And they did not say, 'Where is the Lord who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who guided us in the wilderness, in a boundless and untrodden land, in a waterless and barren land, in a land through which nothing passed and where no man dwelt?'
verses.2:7: And I brought you into Carmel, that you might eat its fruits and its good things; yet you entered and defiled My land, and made My inheritance an abomination.
verses.2:8: The priests did not say, 'Where is the Lord?' And those who hold fast to the law did not know Me; and the shepherds acted impiously against Me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and walked after that which is unprofitable.
verses.2:9: Therefore I will yet contend in judgment with you, and with the sons of your sons I will contend in judgment.
verses.2:10: For go to the islands of Kittim and see, and send to Kedar and consider carefully, and see whether such things have happened,
verses.2:11: whether nations will exchange their gods, though they are not gods; yet My people have exchanged their glory for that from which they shall not profit.
verses.2:12: Heaven was astounded at this and shuddered exceedingly all the more," says the Lord.
verses.2:13: "For My people have committed two evil things: they have forsaken Me, the fountain of the water of life, and have dug for themselves broken cisterns that will not be able to hold water.
verses.2:14: Is Israel a servant, or is he homeborn? Why has he become plunder?
verses.2:15: Lions roared against him and gave forth their voice, who made his land a wilderness, and his cities were demolished so as to be without inhabitant.
verses.2:16: Also the sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and mocked you.
verses.2:17: Has not your forsaking Me done these things to you?" says the Lord your God.
verses.2:18: "And now what have you to do with the way of Egypt, to drink the water of Gihon? And what have you to do with the way of the Assyrians, to drink the water of rivers?
verses.2:19: Your apostasy shall chasten you, and your wickedness shall reprove you; and know and see that it is bitter for you to have forsaken Me," says the Lord your God; "and I have not been well pleased with you," says the Lord your God.
verses.2:20: "For from of old you have broken your yoke; you have burst your bonds and said, 'I will not serve You, but I will go upon every high hill and beneath every shady tree; there I will spread myself out in my harlotry.'
verses.2:21: Yet I planted you a fruitful vine, wholly true; how have you turned into bitterness, O strange vine?
verses.2:22: Though you wash yourself with lye and multiply soap for yourself, you are stained in your iniquities before Me," says the Lord.
verses.2:23: "How will you say, 'I have not been defiled, and I have not walked after Baal'? See your ways in the burial ground, and know what you have done. At evening her voice wailed;
verses.2:24: she widened her ways to the waters of the wilderness; in the desires of her soul she was carried away by the wind; she was given over. Who shall turn her back? All who seek her shall not grow weary; in her humiliation they shall find her.
verses.2:25: Turn back your foot from a rough way, and your throat from thirst. But she said, 'I will strengthen myself,' for she had loved strangers, and after them she walked.
verses.2:26: As is the shame of a thief when he is caught, so shall the sons of Israel be put to shame—they and their kings and their rulers and their priests and their prophets.
verses.2:27: To the wood they said, 'You are my father,' and to the stone, 'You brought me forth.' Yet they have turned their backs to Me, and not their faces; and in the time of their calamities they will say, 'Arise and save us!'
verses.2:28: And where are your gods which you made for yourself? Will they arise and save in the time of your affliction? For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah, and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem they sacrificed to Baal.
verses.2:29: Why do you speak to Me? You have all acted impiously, and you have all acted lawlessly against Me," says the Lord.
verses.2:30: "In vain I have struck your children; you did not receive discipline; a sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion, and you did not fear."
verses.2:31: Hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord: "Have I become a wilderness to Israel, or a barren wasteland? Why have My people said, 'We will not be ruled over, and we will come to You no more'?
verses.2:32: Will a bride forget her ornaments, or a virgin her breastband? Yet My people have forgotten Me days without number.
verses.2:33: What fair thing will you yet devise in your ways to seek love? Not so; rather, you yourself have acted wickedly to defile your ways,
verses.2:34: and on your hands was found the blood of innocent souls; I did not find them in breaches, but at every oak.
verses.2:35: Yet you said, 'I am innocent; surely let His wrath be turned away from me.' Behold, I enter into judgment with you, because you say, 'I have not sinned.'
verses.2:36: Why have you made so light of repeating your ways? Indeed, you shall be put to shame by Egypt, just as you were put to shame by Assyria,
verses.2:37: for from there also you shall go forth with your hands upon your head; for the Lord has rejected your hope, and you shall not prosper in it."
verses.3:1: "If a man sends away his wife, and she departs from him and becomes another man's, shall she indeed return to him again? Will not that woman be utterly defiled? Yet you have played the harlot with many shepherds, and would you return to Me?" says the Lord.
verses.3:2: "Lift up your eyes straight ahead and see: where have you not been defiled? By the roads you sat for them like a forsaken crow, and you defiled the land with your harlotries and with your wicked deeds,
verses.3:3: and you had many shepherds as a stumbling block to yourself; you took on the countenance of a harlot, you acted shamelessly toward all.
verses.3:4: Did you not call Me as a house, and Father, and Guide of your maidenhood?
verses.3:5: Will it remain forever, or be kept to the end? Behold, you have spoken and done these evil things, and you prevailed."
verses.3:6: And the Lord said to me in the days of Josiah the king, "Have you seen what the habitation of Israel has done to Me? They went upon every high mountain and under every shady tree, and played the harlot there.
verses.3:7: And I said, after she had committed all these harlotries, 'Return to Me,' yet she did not return; and treacherous Judah saw her treachery.
verses.3:8: And I saw that for all the things which I also saw—for all the things in which the habitation of Israel was caught committing adultery—I sent her away and gave her a certificate of divorce into her hands; yet treacherous Judah did not fear, but she also went and played the harlot,
verses.3:9: and her harlotry came to nothing, and she committed adultery with wood and stone.
verses.3:10: And in all these things treacherous Judah has not turned back to Me with all her heart, but in falsehood."
verses.3:11: And the Lord said to me, "Israel has justified his soul more than treacherous Judah.
verses.3:12: Go and read these words toward the north, and you shall say, 'Return to Me, O habitation of Israel,' says the Lord, 'and I will not set My face against you; for I am merciful,' says the Lord, 'and I will not remain angry with you forever.
verses.3:13: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have acted impiously against the Lord your God, and have scattered your ways to strangers under every shady tree, and you have not obeyed My voice,' says the Lord."
verses.3:14: "Return, O sons who have turned away," says the Lord, "for I will exercise dominion over you; and I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and I will bring you into Zion.
verses.3:15: And I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they shall indeed shepherd you with understanding.
verses.3:16: And it shall come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days," says the Lord, "they shall no longer say, 'The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel.' It shall not come into the heart, nor shall it be named, nor shall it be visited, nor shall it be made anymore.
verses.3:17: In those days and in that time they shall call Jerusalem, 'The Throne of the Lord,' and all the nations shall be gathered to her; and they shall no longer walk after the imaginations of their evil heart.
verses.3:18: In those days the house of Judah shall come together with the house of Israel, and they shall come together from the land of the north and from all the countries to the land that I gave as an inheritance to their fathers."
verses.3:19: And I said, "Let it be so, Lord!" For I will set you among the nations, and give you a choice land, an inheritance of God Almighty of the nations; and I said, "You shall call Me Father, and from Me you shall not turn away."
verses.3:20: "Yet as a woman breaks faith with her companion, so has the house of Israel broken faith with Me," says the Lord.
verses.3:21: A voice from lips was heard, of weeping and supplication of the sons of Israel, because they have done unrighteously in their ways; they have forgotten God their Holy One.
verses.3:22: "Return, O returning sons, and I will heal your brokenness." "Behold, we shall be servants to You, for You are the Lord our God.
verses.3:23: Truly for falsehood were the hills and the strength of the mountains, yet through the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.3:24: But shame has devoured the labors of our fathers from our youth, their sheep and their calves, and their sons and their daughters.
verses.3:25: We have lain down in our shame, and our dishonor has covered us, for we have sinned before our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day, and we have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.4:1: "If Israel returns," says the Lord, "to Me he shall return; if he removes his abominations from his mouth, and stands in awe before the presence,
verses.4:2: and swears, 'The Lord lives,' with truth, in judgment, and in righteousness, then nations shall bless in him, and in him they shall praise God in Jerusalem."
verses.4:3: For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: "Break up for yourselves fallow ground, and do not sow upon thorns.
verses.4:4: Be circumcised to your God, and circumcise your hardness of heart, O men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, lest His wrath go forth like fire and burn, and there be none to quench it, because of the evil of your practices."
verses.4:5: Declare in Judah, and let it be heard in Jerusalem; speak, sound the trumpet in the land, cry aloud; say, "Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities."
verses.4:6: Gather up and flee to Zion; make haste, do not stand still, for I am bringing calamity from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.4:7: A lion has come up from his lair, and the destroyer of nations has set out and gone forth from his place to make the land a desolation; and cities shall be demolished so that they are no longer inhabited.
verses.4:8: For this, gird yourselves with sackcloth, lament and wail, for the wrath of the Lord has not turned away from you.
verses.4:9: "And it shall come to pass in that day," says the Lord, "that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the rulers; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall marvel."
verses.4:10: And I said, "O Sovereign Lord, have You indeed utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, 'There shall be peace,' while behold, the sword has reached even to their soul?"
verses.4:11: At that time they shall say to this people and to Jerusalem, "A spirit of wandering is in the wilderness; the way of the daughter of My people is not toward what is pure, nor toward what is holy.
verses.4:12: A spirit of fullness shall come to Me; and now I speak judgments against them."
verses.4:13: Behold, he shall come up like a cloud, and his chariots like a whirlwind; his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are devastated!
verses.4:14: Wash your heart from wickedness, O Jerusalem, that you may be saved. How long shall the thoughts of your distress remain within you?
verses.4:15: For a voice of one announcing shall come from Dan, and distress shall be heard from Mount Ephraim.
verses.4:16: Remind the nations: behold, they have come; proclaim in Jerusalem, "Bands are coming from a distant land, and they have raised their voice against the cities of Judah."
verses.4:17: "Like watchmen of a field they are all around against her, because you have neglected Me," says the Lord.
verses.4:18: Your ways and your practices have done these things to you; this is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it has reached even to your heart.
verses.4:19: I am in pain in my inward parts, and in the senses of my heart; my soul throbs violently, my heart is convulsed; I will not be silent, for my soul has heard the sound of the trumpet, the cry of war.
verses.4:20: And it calls upon devastation, upon crushing, for the whole land is devastated; suddenly the tent is devastated, my tent-curtains are torn apart.
verses.4:21: How long shall I see fugitives, hearing the sound of trumpets?
verses.4:22: "For the leaders of My people have not known Me; they are foolish sons and without understanding; they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have not known."
verses.4:23: I looked upon the earth, and behold, nothing; and to heaven, and its lights were not there.
verses.4:24: I saw the mountains, and they were trembling, and all the hills were shaken in turmoil.
verses.4:25: I looked, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of heaven were terrified.
verses.4:26: I saw, and behold, Carmel was desolate, and all the cities were burned with fire before the presence of the Lord, and before the presence of the anger of His wrath they were blotted out.
verses.4:27: Thus says the Lord: "All the earth shall be desolate, yet I will by no means make a full end.
verses.4:28: For this let the earth mourn, and let the heaven above be darkened, because I have spoken and I will not relent; I have set forth and I will not turn back from it."
verses.4:29: At the sound of the horseman and the bent bow every region has withdrawn; they crept into the caves, and hid themselves in the groves, and climbed up upon the rocks; every city was forsaken; no man dwelt in them.
verses.4:30: And what will you do if you clothe yourself with scarlet and adorn yourself with ornaments of gold, if you paint your eyes with antimony? In vain is your beautifying; your lovers have rejected you; they seek your life.
verses.4:31: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in labor, of your groaning, as of one bearing her first child: the voice of the daughter of Zion; she shall grow faint, and let her hands drop: "Woe is me, for my soul faints because of the slain!"
verses.5:1: "Run about in the streets of Jerusalem, and look and take note and search in her broad squares, if you can find whether there is one doing justice and seeking faithfulness, and I will be merciful to them," says the Lord.
verses.5:2: "The Lord lives," they say; therefore do they not swear in falsehoods?
verses.5:3: O Lord, Your eyes are toward faithfulness; You scourged them, yet they felt no pain; You consumed them, yet they were not willing to receive discipline; they made their faces harder than rock, and they were not willing to return.
verses.5:4: And I said, "Perhaps they are poor, because they were unable, for they did not know the way of the Lord and the judgment of God;
verses.5:5: I will go to the great men and speak to them, for they have known the way of the Lord and the judgment of God." And behold, with one accord they shattered the yoke, they tore apart the bonds.
verses.5:6: Therefore a lion from the forest has struck them, and a wolf even to the houses has destroyed them, and a leopard has kept watch over their cities; all who go out from them shall be hunted down, because they have multiplied their ungodly deeds and have grown strong in their backslidings.
verses.5:7: "For which of these things shall I be merciful to you? Your sons have forsaken Me and swore by those who are not gods; and I fed them to the full, yet they committed adultery and lodged in the houses of harlots.
verses.5:8: They became lustful stallions; each one neighed after his neighbor's wife.
verses.5:9: Shall I not punish for these things?" says the Lord. "Or shall My soul not take vengeance on such a nation as this?"
verses.5:10: "Go up upon her ramparts and tear them down, yet do not make a complete end; leave behind her foundations, for they belong to the Lord.
verses.5:11: For the house of Israel has indeed dealt treacherously against Me," says the Lord, "and the house of Judah
verses.5:12: has lied against their own Lord, and they said, 'These things are not so; calamity shall not come upon us, and we shall not see sword or famine;
verses.5:13: our prophets have become wind, and the word of the Lord was not in them—so shall it happen to them.'"
verses.5:14: Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty: "Because you have spoken this word, behold, I have put My words into your mouth as fire, and this people as wood, and it shall devour them."
verses.5:15: "Behold, I am bringing upon you a nation from afar, O house of Israel," says the Lord, "a nation the sound of whose language you shall not understand.
verses.5:16: All of them are mighty, and they shall devour your harvest
verses.5:17: and your bread, and they shall devour your sons and your daughters, and they shall devour your sheep and your calves, and they shall devour your vineyards and your fig orchards and your olive groves; and they shall thresh your fortified cities, in which you have trusted, with the sword."
verses.5:18: "And it shall come to pass in those days," says the Lord your God, "that I will by no means bring you to a complete end."
verses.5:19: And it shall come to pass, when you say, "For what reason has the Lord our God done all these things to us?" then you shall say to them, "Because you served foreign gods in your land, so you shall serve strangers in a land not your own."
verses.5:20: Declare these things to the house of Jacob, and let it be heard in Judah:
verses.5:21: Hear now these things, O foolish and senseless people: they have eyes and do not see; they have ears and do not hear.
verses.5:22: "Will you not fear Me?" says the Lord. "Or will you not stand in awe before My presence, who have appointed the sand as a boundary for the sea, an everlasting decree, and it shall not pass over it? Though it is stirred up, yet it shall not prevail; and its waves shall roar, yet it shall not pass over it.
verses.5:23: But this people has come to have a disobedient and rebellious heart; they have turned aside and departed.
verses.5:24: And they did not say in their heart, 'Let us now fear the Lord our God, who gives us the early and the late rain at the season of the fulfillment of the appointed decree of harvest, and He has preserved it for us.'
verses.5:25: Your iniquities have turned these things away, and your sins have withheld good things from you.
verses.5:26: For ungodly men have been found among My people, and they have set snares to destroy men, and they have captured them.
verses.5:27: Like a snare set full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have become great and grown rich,
verses.5:28: and they have transgressed justice; they did not judge the cause of the orphan, nor did they judge the cause of the widow.
verses.5:29: Shall I not punish for these things?" says the Lord. "Or shall My soul not take vengeance on such a nation as this?
verses.5:30: Astonishment and dreadful things have come to pass upon the land:
verses.5:31: the prophets prophesy unrighteous things, and the priests have clapped with their hands, and My people have loved it so; and what will you do for the things that come after?"
verses.6:1: Strengthen yourselves, O sons of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and sound the trumpet in Tekoa, and lift up a signal over Beth-haccerem; for calamity peers forth from the north, and great destruction is coming,
verses.6:2: and your height shall be taken away, O daughter of Zion.
verses.6:3: Shepherds and their flocks shall come to her; they shall pitch tents against her all around, and each one shall pasture with his own hand.
verses.6:4: "Prepare yourselves against her for battle! Arise, and let us go up against her at noon! Woe to us, for the day has declined, for the shadows of the day are fading!
verses.6:5: Arise, and let us go up against her by night, and let us destroy her foundations!"
verses.6:6: For thus says the Lord: "Cut down her trees, pour out an army against Jerusalem! O false city, all oppression is within her.
verses.6:7: As a cistern keeps water cool, so her wickedness keeps cool; ungodliness and misery shall be heard in her, before her face continually.
verses.6:8: With pain and scourge you shall be disciplined, O Jerusalem, lest My soul depart from you, lest I make you an untrodden land that shall not be inhabited."
verses.6:9: For thus says the Lord: "Glean, glean like a vine the remnant of Israel; turn back like the grape-gatherer to his basket."
verses.6:10: To whom shall I speak and bear witness, that he may hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they shall not be able to hear. Behold, the word of the Lord has become a reproach to them; they will by no means desire it.
verses.6:11: "And I have filled My wrath and held it back, and I have not brought them to an end; I will pour it out upon the infants outside, and upon the assembly of young men together; for husband and wife shall be captured, the elder together with the one full of days.
verses.6:12: And their houses shall be turned over to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out My hand against those who dwell in this land," says the Lord.
verses.6:13: "For from the least of them even to the greatest, all have practiced lawless deeds; from priest even to false prophet, all have done falsehood.
verses.6:14: And they healed the crushing of My people, treating it lightly and saying, 'Peace, peace!'—and where is peace?
verses.6:15: They were put to shame because they failed; yet not even as those who are ashamed were they put to shame, and they did not know their dishonor. Therefore they shall fall in their downfall, and in the time of visitation they shall perish," the Lord has said.
verses.6:16: Thus says the Lord: "Stand upon the ways and see, and ask for the everlasting paths of the Lord, and see which is the good way, and walk in it, and you shall find purification for your souls." But they said, "We will not go."
verses.6:17: "I have appointed watchmen over you; listen to the sound of the trumpet!" But they said, "We will not listen."
verses.6:18: Therefore the nations have heard, and those who pasture their flocks.
verses.6:19: "Hear, O earth! Behold, I am bringing calamity upon this people, the fruit of their turning away, because they did not attend to My words, and they cast away My law.
verses.6:20: Why do you bring Me frankincense from Sheba, and cinnamon from a distant land? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices have not been pleasing to Me."
verses.6:21: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I am placing weakness upon this people, and fathers and sons shall grow weak together; neighbor and his companion shall perish."
verses.6:22: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations shall be stirred up from the end of the earth;
verses.6:23: they shall lay hold of bow and spear; he is fierce and shall have no mercy; his voice is like a surging sea; upon horses and chariots he shall draw up in array like fire for battle against you, O daughter of Zion."
verses.6:24: We have heard the report of them; our hands have grown feeble; distress has laid hold of us, pangs like those of a woman in labor.
verses.6:25: Do not go out into the field, and do not walk in the roads, for the sword of the enemies dwells all around.
verses.6:26: O daughter of my people, gird yourself with sackcloth, sprinkle yourself with ashes; make for yourself mourning as for a beloved one, a piteous lamentation, for suddenly misery shall come upon you.
verses.6:27: I have appointed you as a tester among tested peoples, and you shall know Me when I test their way.
verses.6:28: All of them are disobedient, walking crookedly; bronze and iron, all of them are corrupted.
verses.6:29: The bellows have failed from the fire; the lead has failed; in vain the silversmith refines silver; their wickedness has not melted away.
verses.6:30: Call them rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them.
verses.7:2: Hear the word of the Lord, all Judea.
verses.7:3: Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: "Set right your ways and your practices, and I will make you dwell in this place.
verses.7:4: Do not trust in yourselves, in deceitful words, for they will not profit you at all, saying, 'The temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord it is.'
verses.7:5: For if you truly set right your ways and your practices, and if you truly execute justice between a man and his neighbor,
verses.7:6: and do not oppress the sojourner, the orphan, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, nor walk after foreign gods to your own harm,
verses.7:7: then I will make you dwell in this place, in the land which I gave to your fathers from everlasting even to everlasting.
verses.7:8: Yet if you trust in deceitful words, from which you shall not be profited,
verses.7:9: and murder, and commit adultery, and steal, and swear falsely, and burned incense to Baal, and walked after foreign gods whom you do not know, so that it may go ill with you,
verses.7:10: and came and stood before Me in the house upon which My name is called, and said, 'We have abstained from doing all these abominations'—
verses.7:11: is My house, upon which My name is called there in your sight, a den of robbers? And behold, I Myself have seen it," says the Lord.
verses.7:12: "For you went to My place which is in Shiloh, where I caused My name to dwell there before, and saw what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
verses.7:13: And now, because you have done all these works, and I spoke to you and you did not listen to Me, and I called you and you did not answer,
verses.7:14: therefore I will do to the house upon which My name is called, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
verses.7:15: And I will cast you away from My sight, just as I cast away your brethren, all the seed of Ephraim."
verses.7:16: "And as for you, do not pray for this people, and do not plead for mercy to be shown to them, nor make supplication, nor approach Me on their behalf, for I will not listen.
verses.7:17: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.7:18: Their sons gather wood, and their fathers kindle a fire, and their women knead dough to make cakes for the host of heaven, and they have poured out drink offerings to foreign gods that they may provoke Me to anger.
verses.7:19: Is it Me whom they provoke to anger?" says the Lord. "Is it not themselves, that their own faces may be put to shame?"
verses.7:20: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, My anger and My wrath are poured out upon this place, upon man and upon beast, and upon every tree of their field, and upon the produce of the earth; and it shall burn and shall not be quenched."
verses.7:21: Thus says the Lord: "Gather your burnt offerings together with your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.7:22: For I did not speak to your fathers, nor did I command them in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings and sacrifice.
verses.7:23: Rather, this word I commanded them, saying, 'Listen to My voice, and I will be to you a God, and you shall be to Me a people; and walk in all My ways which I shall command you, that it may be well with you.'
verses.7:24: Yet they did not listen to Me, nor did their ear attend, but they walked in the devices of their evil heart, and turned backward and not forward,
verses.7:25: from the day that their fathers came out of the land of Egypt even to this day. And I sent out to you all My servants the prophets by day and at dawn; indeed I sent them,
verses.7:26: yet they did not listen to Me, nor did their ear attend, and they stiffened their neck more than their fathers.
verses.7:27: And you shall speak this word to them:
verses.7:28: 'This is the nation that has not listened to the voice of the Lord, nor received discipline; faithfulness has failed from their mouth.'"
verses.7:29: Shear your head and cast it away, and take up a lamentation upon your lips, for the Lord has rejected and cast off the generation that does these things.
verses.7:30: "For the sons of Judah have done evil in My sight," says the Lord; "they have placed their abominations in the house upon which My name is called, to defile it.
verses.7:31: And they have built the altar of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command them, nor did I conceive in My heart.
verses.7:32: Therefore, behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "when they shall no longer say, 'Altar of Topheth' and 'Valley of the son of Hinnom,' but 'The Valley of the Slain'; and they shall bury in Topheth because there is no place left,
verses.7:33: and the dead bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of heaven and for the wild beasts of the earth, and there shall be no one to drive them away.
verses.7:34: And I will bring to an end from the city of Judah and from the thoroughfares of Jerusalem the voice of those who make merry and the voice of those who rejoice, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the whole land shall become a desolation."
verses.8:1: "At that time," says the Lord, "they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its rulers, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of those who dwell in Jerusalem, out of their tombs;
verses.8:2: and they shall lay them out to dry before the sun and the moon, and before all the stars, and before all the host of heaven, which they loved, and which they served, and after which they walked, and to which they clung, and which they worshiped; they shall not be lamented, nor shall they be buried, and they shall become an example upon the face of the earth,
verses.8:3: because they chose death rather than life—even to all the remnant that are left of that generation, in every place to which I shall drive them out."
verses.8:4: For thus says the Lord: "Does he who falls not rise again? Or does he who turns away not turn back?
verses.8:5: Why has this My people turned away with a shameless turning away, and been held fast in their own choice, and refused to return?
verses.8:6: Give ear now and listen: will they not speak thus? There is no man who repents of his wickedness, saying, 'What have I done?' The runner has ceased from his course, like a sweat-drenched horse in his neighing.
verses.8:7: Even the stork in the heavens knows her appointed time; the turtledove and the swallow of the field, the sparrows, have observed the times of their coming; but My people do not know the judgments of the Lord.
verses.8:8: How will you say, 'We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us'? In vain has a lying reed been made for the scribes.
verses.8:9: The wise have been put to shame, and dismayed, and captured, because they have rejected the law of the Lord; what wisdom is in them?
verses.8:10: Therefore I will give their wives to others, and their fields to the heirs,
verses.8:13: and they shall gather their produce," says the Lord. "There are no grapes on the vines, and there are no figs on the fig trees, and the leaves have fallen off."
verses.8:14: Why are we sitting still? Gather together, and let us enter the fortified cities and be cast away; for God has cast us away and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned before Him.
verses.8:15: We gathered together for peace, and there was no good; for a time of healing, and behold, alarm.
verses.8:16: From Dan we shall hear the sound of the swiftness of his horses; at the sound of the neighing of the riding of his horses the whole earth has quaked; and he shall come and devour the land and its fullness, the city and those who dwell in it.
verses.8:17: "For behold, I am sending out among you deadly serpents, which cannot be charmed, and they shall bite you
verses.8:18: incurably with pain, while your heart is perplexed."
verses.8:19: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land far off: "Is the Lord not in Zion? Or is there no king there?" "Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images and with foreign vanities?"
verses.8:20: "The summer has passed, the harvest has gone by, and we have not been saved."
verses.8:21: For the shattering of the daughter of my people I have been darkened; in perplexity, birth pangs have overpowered me as of a woman in labor.
verses.8:22: Is there no resin in Gilead, or is there no physician there? Why has the healing of the daughter of my people not come up?
verses.8:23: Who will give water to my head, and a fountain of tears to my eyes, that I may weep for this my people day and night, for the wounded of the daughter of my people?
verses.9:1: Who would give me in the wilderness a farthest lodging place, that I might leave my people and depart from them? For they all commit adultery, an assembly of treacherous men,
verses.9:2: and they have bent their tongue like a bow. Falsehood, and not faithfulness, has prevailed upon the land; for they have gone forth from evil to evil, and they have not known Me.
verses.9:3: Beware, each one, of his neighbor, and do not trust in their brethren; for every brother will surely supplant with the heel, and every friend will walk deceitfully.
verses.9:4: Each one will mock his friend, and they will by no means speak the truth; their tongue has learned to speak falsehoods; they have done wrong and have not ceased so as to return.
verses.9:5: Usury upon usury, and deceit upon deceit; they refused to know Me.
verses.9:6: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will refine them by fire and test them, for I will act because of the wickedness of the daughter of My people.
verses.9:7: Their tongue is a wounding arrow; deceitful are the words of their mouth; one speaks peaceable words to his neighbor, yet in himself he harbors enmity.
verses.9:8: Shall I not punish for these things," says the Lord, "or on such a people shall My soul not take vengeance?
verses.9:9: Take up a wailing over the mountains, and over the paths of the wilderness a lamentation, for they have failed because there are no men; they have not heard the sound of possessions; from the birds of heaven even to the beasts, they have started in dismay; they are gone.
verses.9:10: And I will give Jerusalem over to exile and to be a dwelling place of dragons, and the cities of Judah I will make a desolation, because they are without inhabitant."
verses.9:11: Who is the man of understanding? Let him understand this. And he to whom the word of the mouth of the Lord has come, let him declare to you why the land has perished; it has been kindled like a wilderness, with no one passing through it.
verses.9:12: And the Lord said to me, "Because they have forsaken My law which I set before their face, and have not listened to My voice,
verses.9:13: but have walked after the desires of their evil heart and after the idols which their fathers taught them."
verses.9:14: Therefore thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: "Behold, I will feed them afflictions, and give them water of gall to drink;
verses.9:15: and I will scatter them among the nations which neither they nor their fathers knew, and I will send the sword upon them until I have consumed them by it."
verses.9:16: Thus says the Lord: "Call for the mourning women, and let them come; and send for the skillful women, and let them sound forth,
verses.9:17: and let them take up a lamentation over you, and let your eyes bring down tears, and let your eyelids flow with water.
verses.9:18: For a voice of lamentation is heard in Zion: 'How we are brought to ruin! We are greatly put to shame, because we have forsaken the land and cast away our dwellings!'"
verses.9:19: Hear now, O women, the word of God, and let your ears receive the words of His mouth; teach your daughters wailing, and each woman her neighbor a lamentation.
verses.9:20: For death has climbed up through your windows; it has entered into your land to cut off infants from outside and young men from the broad streets.
verses.9:21: And the corpses of men shall be for an example upon the face of the open field of your land, like grass behind the reaper, and there shall be no one to gather them.
verses.9:22: Thus says the Lord: "Do not let the wise man boast in his wisdom, and do not let the strong man boast in his strength, and do not let the rich man boast in his wealth;
verses.9:23: but rather let him who boasts boast in this: that he understands and knows that I am the Lord, who exercises mercy and judgment and righteousness upon the earth; for in these things is My will," says the Lord.
verses.9:24: "Behold, days are coming," says the Lord, "that I will visit punishment upon all who are circumcised in their foreskins:
verses.9:25: upon Egypt, and upon Idumea, and upon Edom, and upon the sons of Ammon, and upon the sons of Moab, and upon every one who clips the hair around his face, those who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised in the flesh, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in their heart."
verses.10:1: Hear the word of the Lord which He has spoken concerning you, O house of Israel.
verses.10:2: Thus says the Lord: "Do not learn according to the ways of the nations, and do not be terrified by the signs of heaven, for they fear them in their countenances.
verses.10:3: For the customs of the nations are vain: it is wood cut out from the forest, the work of a craftsman and a cast image,
verses.10:4: adorned with silver and gold; with hammers and nails they have fastened them.
verses.10:9: They shall set them up, and they shall not be moved; it is chased silver, they shall not walk; plated silver shall come from Tarshish, and gold of Mophaz, and the hand of goldsmiths—all are the works of artisans. With blue and purple they shall clothe them. They must surely be carried, for they cannot take a step. Do not fear them, for they will by no means do evil, nor is there any good in them."
verses.10:11: Thus you shall say to them: "Let the gods who have not made heaven and earth perish from the earth and from beneath this heaven."
verses.10:12: It is the Lord who made the earth by His strength, who set upright the inhabited world by His wisdom, and by His understanding stretched out heaven
verses.10:13: and a multitude of waters in heaven; and He brought up clouds from the farthest end of the earth; He made lightnings for the rain, and brought forth light out of His treasuries.
verses.10:14: Every man has become foolish, devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his carved images, for he has cast falsehoods, and there is no breath in them.
verses.10:15: They are vain, works of mockery; in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.10:16: Not such is the portion of Jacob, for He who formed all things is Himself his inheritance; the Lord is His name.
verses.10:17: He has gathered your substance from outside, O you who dwell in choice places.
verses.10:18: For thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will trip up the inhabitants of this land in affliction, so that your wound may be found."
verses.10:19: Woe for your ruin! Grievous is your blow! And I said, "Truly this is your wound, and it has overtaken you."
verses.10:20: Your tent is ruined; it has perished, and all your tent curtains have been torn apart; my sons and my sheep are no more; there is no longer a place for my tent, a place for my curtains.
verses.10:21: For the shepherds have acted foolishly and have not sought the Lord; therefore the whole pasture has not understood, and they have been scattered.
verses.10:22: Behold, the sound of a report is coming, and a great shaking from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation and a lair of ostriches.
verses.10:23: I know, O Lord, that a man's way does not belong to him, nor shall a man walk and direct his own course.
verses.10:24: Chasten us, O Lord, yet in judgment and not in wrath, lest You make us few.
verses.10:25: Pour out Your wrath upon the nations that do not know You, and upon the generations that have not called upon Your name; for they have devoured Jacob and consumed him, and laid waste his pasture.
verses.11:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.11:2: "Hear the words of this covenant, and you shall speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
verses.11:3: and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: Cursed is the man who does not listen to the words of this covenant,
verses.11:4: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying: Listen to My voice, and do all that I command you; and you shall be My people, and I will be your God,
verses.11:5: that I may establish My oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day.'" And I answered and said, "So be it, O Lord."
verses.11:6: And the Lord said to me, "Read aloud these words in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, saying, 'Hear the words of this covenant and do them.'"
verses.11:8: And they did not do them.
verses.11:9: And the Lord said to me, "A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among those who dwell in Jerusalem.
verses.11:10: They have turned back to the iniquities of their former fathers, who refused to listen to My words; and behold, they themselves walk after foreign gods to serve them. Both the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers."
verses.11:11: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I am bringing upon this people calamities from which they shall not be able to come forth; and they shall cry out to Me, and I will not listen to them.
verses.11:12: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem shall go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, yet they shall by no means save them in the time of their calamities.
verses.11:13: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the outlets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to burn incense to Baal.
verses.11:14: And as for you, do not pray for this people, and do not intercede for them with supplication and prayer; for I will not listen in the time when they call upon Me, in the time of their affliction.
verses.11:15: Why has the beloved one committed an abomination in My house? Shall vows and holy flesh take away your wickednesses from you, or by these shall you escape?
verses.11:16: A fair olive tree, well-shaded in appearance, the Lord called your name. At the sound of her pruning, fire was kindled against her; great is the affliction upon you; her branches have been made useless,
verses.11:17: and the Lord who planted you has spoken calamity against you because of the wickedness of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, for they have done this for themselves, to provoke Me to anger by burning incense to Baal."
verses.11:18: O Lord, make it known to me, and I shall know; then I saw their practices,
verses.11:19: but I, like an innocent lamb led to be sacrificed, did not know. Against me they devised an evil scheme, saying, "Come, and let us cast wood into his bread, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, and his name shall no longer be remembered."
verses.11:20: O Lord, who judges righteously, who tests the inward parts and hearts, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have revealed my just cause.
verses.11:21: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth who seek my life, who say, "You shall by no means prophesy in the name of the Lord, or else you shall die by our hands":
verses.11:22: "Behold, I will visit punishment upon them: their young men shall die by the sword, and their sons and their daughters shall perish by famine,
verses.11:23: and there shall be no remnant of them; for I will bring calamities upon those who dwell in Anathoth in the year of their visitation."
verses.12:1: You are righteous, O Lord, when I make my defense before You; yet I will speak of judgments to You. Why is it that the way of the ungodly prospers? Have all those who commit treacherous deeds flourished?
verses.12:2: You planted them, and they took root; they bore children and brought forth fruit. You are near to their mouth, yet far from their inward parts.
verses.12:3: But You, O Lord, know me; You have tested my heart before You. Consecrate them for the day of their slaughter.
verses.12:4: How long shall the land mourn, and all the grass of the field wither, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it? The beasts and the birds have perished, because they said, "God will not see our ways."
verses.12:5: Your own feet run and weary you; how will you prepare yourself against horses? And in a land of peace you have no confidence; how will you do in the arrogance of the Jordan?
verses.12:6: For even your brethren and the house of your father—even they have dealt treacherously with you, and they themselves have cried out; from behind you they have gathered together. Do not trust in them, even though they speak fair words to you.
verses.12:7: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance; I have given My beloved soul into the hands of her enemies.
verses.12:8: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in a forest; she has lifted up her voice against Me; therefore I have hated her.
verses.12:9: Is My inheritance to Me a hyena's cave, or a cave all around her? Go, gather all the wild beasts of the field, and let them come to devour her.
verses.12:10: Many shepherds have ruined My vineyard; they have defiled My portion; they have turned My pleasant portion into an untrodden wilderness.
verses.12:11: It has been consigned to a desolation of ruin; because of Me the whole land has been utterly laid waste, because there is no man who lays it to heart.
verses.12:12: Upon every pass in the wilderness destroyers have come, for the sword of the Lord shall devour from the end of the earth; there is no peace for any flesh.
verses.12:13: Sow wheat, and reap thorns! Their portions shall not profit them. Be ashamed of your boasting, because of the reproach before the Lord.
verses.12:14: For thus says the Lord concerning all the wicked neighbors who touch My inheritance which I apportioned to My people Israel: "Behold, I am tearing them away from their land, and I will cast out Judah from the midst of them.
verses.12:15: And it shall come to pass, after I have cast them out, that I will turn again and have mercy on them, and I will settle them, each one in his inheritance and each one in his land.
verses.12:16: And it shall come to pass, if they diligently learn the way of My people, to swear by My name, 'As the Lord lives,' just as they taught My people to swear by Baal, then they shall be built up in the midst of My people;
verses.12:17: but if they will not return, then I will remove that nation with utter removal and destruction."
verses.13:1: Thus says the Lord: "Go and buy for yourself a linen loincloth, and put it around your waist, and it shall not pass through water."
verses.13:2: So I bought the loincloth according to the word of the Lord, and put it around my waist.
verses.13:3: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.13:4: "Take the loincloth that is around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in the cleft of the rock."
verses.13:5: So I went and hid it at the Euphrates, just as the Lord had commanded me.
verses.13:6: And it came to pass after many days that the Lord said to me, "Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the loincloth which I commanded you to hide there."
verses.13:7: So I went to the river Euphrates and dug, and I took the loincloth from the place where I had buried it; and behold, it was ruined, so that it could not be used for anything.
verses.13:8: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.13:9: "Thus says the Lord: 'In this manner I will ruin the arrogance of Judah and the arrogance of Jerusalem,
verses.13:10: this great arrogance—those who refuse to obey My words, and who have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them; and they shall be like this loincloth, which shall be useful for nothing.
verses.13:11: For just as the loincloth clings around the waist of a man, so I caused the house of Israel and all the house of Judah to cling to Myself, to become for Me a renowned people, and a boast, and a glory; yet they did not listen to Me.'
verses.13:12: And you shall say to this people, 'Every wineskin shall be filled with wine.' And it shall come to pass, if they say to you, 'Do we not surely know that every wineskin shall be filled with wine?'
verses.13:13: then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am filling the inhabitants of this land, and their kings—the sons of David who sit upon their throne—and the priests, and the prophets, and Judah, and all who dwell in Jerusalem, with drunkenness;
verses.13:14: and I will scatter them, a man and his brother, and their fathers and their sons together. I will not yearn after them, says the Lord, and I will not spare, nor will I have compassion so as not to destroy them.'"
verses.13:15: Hear and give ear, and do not exalt yourselves, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.13:16: Give glory to the Lord your God before it grows dark, and before your feet stumble upon dark mountains; and you shall wait for light, yet there shall be the shadow of death, and they shall be turned into darkness.
verses.13:17: But if you will not listen, your soul shall weep in secret because of arrogance, and your eyes shall bring down tears, for the flock of the Lord has been crushed.
verses.13:18: Say to the king and to those who rule, "Humble yourselves and sit down, for the crown of your glory has been taken down from your head."
verses.13:19: The cities toward the south have been shut up, and there was no one to open them; Judah has been carried into exile; they have completed an utter exile.
verses.13:20: Lift up your eyes, O Jerusalem, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, the sheep of your glory?
verses.13:21: What will you say when they visit you? For you yourself taught them lessons against you to hold dominion. Shall not birth pangs seize you, like a woman in labor?
verses.13:22: And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things come upon me?" Because of the multitude of your iniquity, your back parts have been uncovered, that your heels might be exposed to public shame.
verses.13:23: Can an Ethiopian change his skin, or a leopard its spots? Then you also will be able to do good, who have learned evil ways.
verses.13:24: And I scattered them like dry twigs driven by the wind into a wilderness.
verses.13:25: This is your lot and the portion of your disobedience to Me, says the Lord; since you have forgotten Me and put your hope in falsehoods,
verses.13:26: I also will uncover your back parts over your face, and your dishonor shall be seen,
verses.13:27: even your adultery, and your neighing, and the estrangement of your harlotry. Upon the hills and in the fields I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, O Jerusalem, because you have not been cleansed after Me—how much longer yet?
verses.14:1: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.
verses.14:2: Judea has mourned, and her gates have been emptied; they have grown dark upon the ground, and the outcry of Jerusalem has gone up.
verses.14:3: And her nobles sent their young men for water; they came to the wells and found no water, and they brought back their vessels empty.
verses.14:4: And the works of the land failed, because there was no rain; the farmers were ashamed, and they covered their heads.
verses.14:5: Even the does in the field gave birth and abandoned their young, because there was no herbage.
verses.14:6: Wild donkeys stood upon the ravines; they gasped for the wind; their eyes failed, because there was no grass.
verses.14:7: Our sins have stood against us; O Lord, act for us for Your own sake, for our sins are many before You, because against You we have sinned.
verses.14:8: O Hope of Israel, O Lord, You who save in a time of troubles, why have You become like a sojourner in the land, and like a native turning aside to a lodging place?
verses.14:9: Shall You be like a man asleep, or like a man unable to save? Yet You are in our midst, O Lord, and Your name has been called upon us; do not forget us!
verses.14:10: Thus says the Lord to this people: "They have loved to move their feet and have not held back, and God has not prospered them; now He will remember their iniquity."
verses.14:11: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not pray for this people for their good;
verses.14:12: for when they fast, I will not hear their supplication, and when they offer burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not be pleased with them; for by the sword, and by famine, and by death I will make an end of them."
verses.14:13: And I said, "O Existing One, Lord, behold, their prophets prophesy and say, 'You shall not see the sword, nor shall famine be among you, for I will give truth and peace upon the land and in this place.'"
verses.14:14: And the Lord said to me, "The prophets prophesy lies in My name; I did not send them, nor did I command them, nor did I speak to them. For false visions, and divinations, and omens, and the purposes of their own heart they prophesy to you.
verses.14:15: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who prophesy lies in My name—though I did not send them—who say, 'Sword and famine shall not be upon this land': By a pestilent death they shall die, and by famine the prophets shall be consumed,
verses.14:16: and the people to whom they prophesy; and they shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the sword and the famine, and there shall be no one to bury them, or their wives, or their sons, or their daughters; and I will pour out their evils upon them.
verses.14:17: And you shall say to them this word: 'Bring down tears upon your eyes day and night, and let them not cease; for the daughter of my people has been shattered with a great shattering, and with an exceedingly grievous blow.
verses.14:18: If I go out into the plain, behold, those slain by the sword! And if I enter into the city, behold, the torment of famine! For priest and prophet have gone into a land which they did not know.'"
verses.14:19: Have You utterly rejected Judah, and has Your soul departed from Zion? Why have You struck us, so that there is no healing for us? We waited for peace, and there was no good; for a time of healing, and behold, turmoil!
verses.14:20: We acknowledge, O Lord, our sins, the iniquities of our fathers, for we have sinned before You.
verses.14:21: Relent for Your name's sake; do not destroy the throne of Your glory. Remember, do not break Your covenant with us.
verses.14:22: Is there among the idols of the nations any that sends rain? Or can heaven give its abundance? Are You not He? And we will wait upon You, O Lord, for You have made all these things.
verses.15:1: And the Lord said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel stand before My face, My soul is not toward them; send this people away, and let them go out.
verses.15:2: And it shall be, if they say to you, 'Where shall we go out?' then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: As many as are for death, to death; and as many as are for the sword, to the sword; and as many as are for famine, to famine; and as many as are for captivity, to captivity.'
verses.15:3: And I will bring vengeance upon them with four kinds, says the Lord: the sword for slaughter, and the dogs for tearing apart, and the beasts of the earth and the birds of heaven for devouring and destruction.
verses.15:4: And I will deliver them into distresses to all the kingdoms of the earth because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for all that he did in Jerusalem.
verses.15:5: Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? And who will be dismayed over you? Or who will turn back for your peace?
verses.15:6: You have turned away from Me, says the Lord; you shall go backward; and I will stretch out My hand and destroy you, and I will no longer spare them.
verses.15:7: And I will scatter them in dispersion; in the gates of My people they were made childless; they have destroyed My people because of their wickedness,
verses.15:8: their widows were multiplied more than the sand of the sea. I brought young men against a mother, distress at midday; they suddenly cast upon her trembling and alarm.
verses.15:9: She who bears seven was emptied, her soul grew faint; her sun went down while it was still midday; she was put to shame and reproached. The remnant of them I will give to the sword before their enemies."
verses.15:10: Woe is me, mother, as whom did you bear me? A man disputing and contending in all the earth! Neither have I profited anyone, nor has anyone profited me; my strength has failed among those who curse me.
verses.15:11: May it be so, O Master, while they prosper, if I did not stand before You in the time of their calamities and in the time of their affliction, for good against the enemy.
verses.15:12: Will iron be known? And a covering of bronze is your strength.
verses.15:13: And your treasures I will give for plunder, as an exchange for all your sins and in all your borders.
verses.15:14: And I will enslave you on every side to your enemies in the land which you did not know; for a fire has been kindled out of My wrath; upon you it shall burn.
verses.15:15: O Lord, remember me and visit me, and vindicate me from those who pursue me, not with longsuffering; know that for Your sake I have borne reproach
verses.15:16: from those who reject Your words; make an end of them! And Your word shall be to me for gladness and joy of my heart, for Your name has been called upon me, O Lord Almighty.
verses.15:17: I did not sit in their assembly while they made merry, but I stood in awe before Your hand; I sat alone, for I was filled with bitterness.
verses.15:18: Why do those who grieve me prevail against me? My wound is severe; from where shall I be healed? Indeed, it has become to me like deceitful water, having no faithfulness.
verses.15:19: Therefore thus says the Lord: "If you return, then I will restore you, and you shall stand before My face; and if you bring forth the precious from the cheap, you shall be as My mouth. And they shall turn back to you, and you shall not turn back to them.
verses.15:20: And I will make you to this people as a fortified bronze wall; and they shall fight against you, yet they shall by no means prevail against you, for I am with you to save you
verses.15:21: and to deliver you from the hand of wicked men, and I will redeem you from the hand of pestilent men."
verses.16:1: "And you, do not take a wife," says the Lord God of Israel,
verses.16:2: "and neither son nor daughter shall be born to you in this place."
verses.16:3: For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who have borne them, and concerning their fathers who have fathered them in this land:
verses.16:4: "By a death of sickness they shall die; they shall not be lamented, nor shall they be buried. They shall be for an example upon the face of the earth, and they shall be for the beasts of the earth and for the birds of heaven; by the sword they shall fall, and by famine they shall be consumed."
verses.16:5: Thus says the Lord: "Do not enter into their company of revelry, and do not go to lament, nor mourn for them, for I have withdrawn My peace from this people.
verses.16:6: They shall by no means lament for them, nor shall they make incisions, and they shall not shave themselves;
verses.16:7: and bread shall by no means be broken in their mourning for comfort over the dead; they shall not give him a cup to drink for comfort over his father and his mother.
verses.16:8: You shall not enter into a house of drinking to sit down with them to eat and to drink."
verses.16:9: For thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Behold, I am causing to cease from this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
verses.16:10: And it shall come to pass, when you declare to this people all these words, and they say to you, 'Why has the Lord spoken all these evils against us? What is our unrighteousness? And what is our sin which we have sinned before the Lord our God?'
verses.16:11: then you shall say to them, 'Because your fathers forsook Me, says the Lord, and went after foreign gods and served them and worshiped them, and forsook Me and did not keep My law,
verses.16:12: and you have acted more wickedly than your fathers; and behold, you walk, each one after what pleases your evil heart, so as not to obey Me.
verses.16:13: And I will cast you away from this land into the land which you and your fathers did not know, and there you shall serve other gods, who will not show you mercy.'"
verses.16:14: "Therefore, behold, days are coming," says the Lord, "and they shall no longer say, 'The Lord lives, who brought up the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt,'
verses.16:15: but, 'The Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel from the land of the north and from all the countries where they were driven out.' And I will restore them to their own land which I gave to their fathers.
verses.16:16: Behold, I am sending many fishermen," says the Lord, "and they shall fish for them; and after this I will send many hunters, and they shall hunt them upon every mountain and upon every hill and out of the clefts of the rocks.
verses.16:17: For My eyes are upon all their ways, and their unrighteous deeds have not been hidden from before My eyes.
verses.16:18: And I will repay for all their evils and their sins, by which they profaned My land with the carcasses of their abominations and with their lawless deeds, by which they trespassed against My inheritance."
verses.16:19: O Lord, You are my strength and my help and my refuge in days of evil; to You nations shall come from the end of the earth and say, "How false are the idols our fathers possessed, and there is no profit in them!"
verses.16:20: Shall a man make gods for himself, when these are not gods?
verses.16:21: Therefore, behold, I will reveal My hand to them at this time, and I will make known to them My power; and they shall know that My name is the Lord.
verses.17:5: Cursed is the man who has his hope in man, and who rests the flesh of his arm upon him, and whose heart departs from the Lord.
verses.17:6: And he shall be like the wild tamarisk in the wilderness; he shall not see when good things come, and he shall dwell in salty wastes and in the wilderness, in a salt land which is not inhabited.
verses.17:7: And blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and the Lord shall be his hope.
verses.17:8: And he shall be like a flourishing tree beside waters, and toward moisture it shall send out its root; it shall not fear when heat comes, and upon it shall be lush branches; in a year of drought it shall not fear, and it shall not cease yielding fruit.
verses.17:9: Deep is the heart above all things, and he is a man; and who shall know him?
verses.17:10: I am the Lord, examining hearts and testing the inward parts, to give to each one according to his ways and according to the fruits of his doings.
verses.17:11: The partridge has cried out and gathered what she did not bring forth; so is he who makes his wealth without justice: in the midst of his days they shall forsake him, and at his end he shall be a fool.
verses.17:12: An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary.
verses.17:13: O Expectation of Israel, Lord, let all who forsake You be put to shame; let those who have departed be written upon the earth, for they have forsaken the fountain of life, the Lord.
verses.17:14: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved, for You are my boast.
verses.17:15: Behold, they say to me, "Where is the word of the Lord? Let it come!"
verses.17:16: But I have not grown weary in following after You, nor have I desired the day of man; You know. What goes forth through my lips is before Your face.
verses.17:17: Do not become an estrangement to me, You who spare me in an evil day.
verses.17:18: Let those who persecute me be put to shame, and may I not be put to shame; let them be terrified, and may I not be terrified. Bring upon them an evil day, and crush them with a double crushing.
verses.17:19: Thus says the Lord: "Go and stand in the gates of the sons of your people, by which the kings of Judah enter and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem,
verses.17:20: and you shall speak to them the word of the Lord: 'Kings of Judah, and all Judea, and all Jerusalem, who enter by these gates,
verses.17:21: thus says the Lord: Guard your souls, and do not carry burdens on the Sabbath day, and do not go out by the gates of Jerusalem,
verses.17:22: and do not bring burdens out of your houses on the Sabbath day, and you shall do no work; sanctify the Sabbath day, just as I commanded your fathers. Yet they did not listen, nor did they incline their ear,
verses.17:23: and they stiffened their neck more than their fathers, so as not to listen to Me and not to receive instruction.
verses.17:24: And it shall come to pass, if you listen to Me, says the Lord, so as not to bring burdens in through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and to sanctify the Sabbath day so as not to do any work,
verses.17:25: then there shall enter through the gates of this city kings and rulers sitting upon the throne of David, riding upon their chariots and horses—they and their rulers, the men of Judah and those who dwell in Jerusalem—and this city shall be inhabited forever;
verses.17:26: and they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from round about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lowland, and from the mountain, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifice and incense and manna and frankincense, bringing praise into the house of the Lord.
verses.17:27: And it shall come to pass, if you do not listen to Me to sanctify the Sabbath day, not to carry burdens and not to enter by the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the streets of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.'"
verses.18:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.18:2: "Arise and go down to the house of the potter, and there you shall hear My words."
verses.18:3: So I went down to the house of the potter, and behold, he was making a work upon the stones,
verses.18:4: and the vessel that he was making fell in his hands; and again he made it another vessel, just as it seemed pleasing before him to make.
verses.18:5: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.18:6: "Shall I not be able to deal with you just as this potter does, O house of Israel? Behold, as the clay of the potter, you are in My hands.
verses.18:7: In the end I will speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom, to pluck them up and to destroy,
verses.18:8: and if that nation turns back from all their evils, then I will relent concerning the evils that I purposed to do to them.
verses.18:9: And in the end I will speak concerning a nation and a kingdom, to be built up and to be planted,
verses.18:10: and if they do wicked things before Me, so as not to listen to My voice, then I will relent concerning the good things that I spoke of doing for them.
verses.18:11: And now speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, 'Behold, I am fashioning evils against you, and I am devising a plan against you; let each one turn away now from his wicked way, and you shall make your practices better.'"
verses.18:12: And they said, "We will act courageously, for we will walk after our turnings away, and we will each do the things pleasing to his wicked heart."
verses.18:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Inquire now among the nations, 'Who has heard such horrifying things that the virgin Israel has exceedingly done?'
verses.18:14: Will breasts fail from a rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water violently carried by the wind turn aside?
verses.18:15: For My people have forgotten Me; they have burned incense in vain, and they shall falter in their ways, the ancient tracks, so as to tread paths that have no way for traveling,
verses.18:16: to appoint their land for desolation and a perpetual hissing; all who pass through it shall be astonished and shall shake their head.
verses.18:17: Like a scorching wind I will scatter them before the face of their enemies; I will show them the day of their destruction."
verses.18:18: And they said, "Come, let us devise a plan against Jeremiah, for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the discerning, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and we will listen to all his words."
verses.18:19: Listen to me, O Lord, and hear the voice of my plea.
verses.18:20: Shall evil things be repaid in return for good things? For they have spoken words together against my soul, and their punishment they have hidden for me. Remember that I stood before Your face to speak good things on their behalf, to turn away Your wrath from them.
verses.18:21: Therefore give their sons over to famine, and gather them into the hands of the sword; let their wives become childless and widows, and let their husbands be slain by death, and their young men fallen by the sword in battle.
verses.18:22: Let an outcry arise in their houses; You shall bring robbers upon them suddenly, because they undertook a word for my capture and hid snares against me.
verses.18:23: And You, O Lord, have known all their counsel against me for death; do not acquit their iniquities, and do not blot out their sins from before Your face. Let their weakness be before You; in the time of Your wrath, deal with them.
verses.19:1: Then the Lord said to me, "Go and acquire a molded earthen flask, and you shall bring some of the elders of the people and of the priests,
verses.19:2: and you shall go out to the burial ground of the sons of their children, which is at the entrance of the Gate of Tharseis, and read there all these words that I shall speak to you;
verses.19:3: and you shall say to them, 'Hear the word of the Lord, O kings of Judah and men of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem, and those who enter through these gates: Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this place, so that the ears of everyone who hears them shall ring,
verses.19:4: because they have forsaken Me and estranged this place, and have burned incense in it to strange gods whom they and their fathers did not know; and the kings of Judah have filled this place with innocent blood,
verses.19:5: and they have built high places to Baal, to burn their sons in fire; I did not command it, nor did I conceive it in My heart.
verses.19:6: Therefore, behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place shall not be called Downfall and Burial Ground of the Son of Hinnom, but rather Burial Ground of the Slaughter.
verses.19:7: And I will slaughter the counsel of Judah and the counsel of Jerusalem in this place, and I will cast them down by the sword before their enemies and by the hands of those who seek their lives; and I will give their dead bodies as food for the birds of heaven and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.19:8: And I will bring this city down to desolation and to a hissing; everyone who passes by it shall look gloomy and shall hiss because of all its plague.
verses.19:9: And they shall eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each one shall eat the flesh of his neighbor in the enclosure and siege with which their enemies shall besiege them.'
verses.19:10: And you shall shatter the flask before the eyes of the men who go out with you,
verses.19:11: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: So will I shatter this people and this city, just as an earthen vessel is shattered, which cannot be mended.
verses.19:12: For thus will I do, says the Lord, to this place and to those who dwell in it, to give this city over like the one that falls to ruin.
verses.19:13: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah shall be like the place that falls to ruin, because of their uncleannesses in all the houses in which they burned incense upon their rooftops to all the host of heaven and poured out drink offerings to strange gods.'"
verses.19:14: Then Jeremiah came from the Downfall, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of the Lord and said to all the people,
verses.19:15: "Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing upon this city and upon all its cities and upon its villages all the evils that I have spoken against it, because they have hardened their neck so as not to listen to My commandments."
verses.20:1: Now Pashhur the son of Immer, the priest—and he had been appointed overseer of the house of the Lord—heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
verses.20:2: And he struck him and cast him into the dungeon that was in the gate of the upper house set apart, which was in the house of the Lord.
verses.20:3: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the dungeon, and Jeremiah said to him, "The Lord has not called your name Pashhur, but rather Exile.
verses.20:4: For thus says the Lord, 'Behold, I am giving you over to exile with all your friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall see it; and I will give you and all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they shall carry them into exile and cut them down with swords.
verses.20:5: And I will give all the strength of this city, and all its labors, and all the treasures of the king of Judah into the hands of his enemies, and they shall lead them away to Babylon.
verses.20:6: And you, and all who dwell in your house, shall go into captivity; and in Babylon you shall die, and there you shall be buried—you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied falsehoods.'"
verses.20:7: You have deceived me, O Lord, and I was deceived; You have been strong and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock; all the day long I have continued to be mocked.
verses.20:8: For with my bitter word I shall laugh; treachery and misery I shall call upon, because the word of the Lord has become a reproach to me and a derision all my day.
verses.20:9: And I said, "I will by no means mention the name of the Lord, nor will I speak anymore in His name." Yet it became like a burning fire blazing in my bones, and I am exhausted on every side and cannot bear it;
verses.20:10: for I have heard the censure of many gathering all around, all around: "Conspire, and let us conspire against him, all men who are his friends! Watch his design, whether he may be deceived, and we shall prevail against him and take our vengeance from him."
