verses.20:11: But the Lord is with me like a mighty warrior; therefore they pursued and could not understand. They were greatly shamed, because they did not understand their disgraces, which shall not be forgotten forever.
verses.20:12: O Lord, who tests righteous things, who understands inward parts and hearts, may I see the vengeance from You upon them, for to You I have revealed my pleas.
verses.20:13: Sing to the Lord, praise Him, for He has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
verses.20:14: Cursed be the day on which I was born! The day on which my mother bore me—let it not be blessed!
verses.20:15: Cursed be the man who brought good tidings to my father, saying, "A male child has been born to you," rejoicing.
verses.20:16: Let that man be like the cities that the Lord overthrew in wrath and did not relent; let him hear an outcry in the morning and a battle shout at midday,
verses.20:17: because he did not slay me in the womb, so that my mother might have become my grave, and her womb one of everlasting conception.
verses.20:18: Why is this that I came forth from the womb to see toils and sorrows, and my days have ended in shame?
verses.21:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchiah and Zephaniah the son of Manassaeus, the priest, saying,
verses.21:2: "Inquire of the Lord on our behalf, for the king of Babylon has come against us, whether the Lord will act according to all His wondrous works, and he will depart from us."
verses.21:3: Then Jeremiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to Zedekiah king of Judah:
verses.21:4: 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am turning back the weapons of war with which you fight against the Chaldeans, who have shut you in outside the wall, into the midst of this city;
verses.21:5: and I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a mighty arm, with fury and great wrath.
verses.21:6: And I will strike all who dwell in this city, both people and beasts, with a great death, and they shall die.
verses.21:7: And afterward, thus says the Lord: I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people who are left in this city from death, and from famine, and from the sword, into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives; and they shall cut them down with the edge of the sword. I will not spare them, nor will I have compassion on them.'"
verses.21:8: And to this people you shall say, "Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have set before your face the way of life and the way of death.
verses.21:9: He who abides in this city shall die by the sword and by famine; but he who goes out to surrender to the Chaldeans who have shut you in shall live, and his life shall be as spoil, and he shall live.
verses.21:10: For I have set My face against this city for evil and not for good; it shall be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire."
verses.21:11: O house of the king of Judah, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.21:12: O house of David, thus says the Lord: "Execute judgment in the morning and make it right, and deliver the plundered from the hand of him who wrongs him, lest My wrath be kindled like fire and burn, and there be none to quench it.
verses.21:13: Behold, I am against you who dwell in the valley of Sor, the plain, who say, 'Who will terrify us? Or who will enter the dwelling place?'
verses.21:14: And I will kindle a fire in its forest, and it shall devour all things round about it."
verses.22:1: Thus says the Lord: "Go and descend to the house of the king of Judah, and you shall speak this word there,
verses.22:2: and you shall say, 'Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Judah who sits on the throne of David, you and your house and your people and those who enter through these gates:
verses.22:3: Thus says the Lord: Execute judgment and righteousness, and deliver the plundered from the hand of him who wrongs him; and do not oppress the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, and do not act ungodly, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.22:4: For if you indeed do this word, then kings sitting on the throne of David and riding on chariots and horses shall enter through the gates of this house, they and their servants and their people.
verses.22:5: But if you do not do these words, I have sworn by Myself, says the Lord, that this house shall become a desolation.'"
verses.22:6: For thus says the Lord against the house of the king of Judah: "You are Gilead to Me, the head of Lebanon; surely I will make you a wilderness, cities that shall not be inhabited.
verses.22:7: And I will bring upon you a destroying man and his axe, and they shall cut down your choice cedars and cast them into the fire.
verses.22:8: And nations shall pass through this city, and each one shall say to his neighbor, 'Why has the Lord done thus to this great city?'
verses.22:9: And they shall say, 'Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshiped foreign gods and served them.'"
verses.22:10: Do not weep for the dead, nor lament for him; weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he shall return no more, nor shall he see the land of his native country.
verses.22:11: For thus says the Lord concerning Shallum the son of Josiah, who reigned in the place of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: "He shall not return there anymore,
verses.22:12: but in the place where I have exiled him, there he shall die, and he shall see this land no more."
verses.22:13: He who builds his house not with righteousness and his upper chambers not with justice makes his neighbor work for nothing, and will by no means pay him his wages.
verses.22:14: You have built for yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper chambers fitted with windows, paneled with cedar and painted with vermilion.
verses.22:15: Shall you reign because you are provoked by Ahaz your father? They shall not eat and they shall not drink; it is better for you to execute judgment and righteousness.
verses.22:16: They did not know; they did not judge the cause of the humble nor the cause of the needy. Is this not that you do not know Me, says the Lord?
verses.22:17: Behold, neither your eyes nor your heart are good, but they are set on your covetousness, and on innocent blood to shed it, and on injustice and on murder to commit them.
verses.22:18: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: "And concerning this man, they shall by no means mourn for him, 'Alas, brother!' nor shall they weep for him, 'Alas, lord!'
verses.22:19: He shall be buried with the burial of a donkey, swept off and cast out beyond the gate of Jerusalem."
verses.22:20: Go up to Lebanon and cry out, and raise your voice in Bashan, and shout to the region beyond the sea; for all your lovers have been crushed.
verses.22:21: I spoke to you in your transgression, and you said, "I will not listen." This has been your way from your youth; you have not listened to My voice.
verses.22:22: The wind shall shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go forth into captivity; for then you shall be ashamed and dishonored because of all who love you.
verses.22:23: O you who dwell in Lebanon, who make your nest in the cedars, you shall groan deeply when pangs come upon you like those of a woman in labor.
verses.22:24: "As I live," says the Lord, "even though Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were indeed a signet on My right hand, yet from there I would pluck you off;
verses.22:25: and I will deliver you into the hands of those who seek your life, whose presence you dread, into the hands of the Chaldeans.
verses.22:26: And I will cast you out, and your mother who bore you, into a land where you were not born, and there you shall die.
verses.22:27: But to the land for which they long in their souls, they shall by no means return."
verses.22:28: Jeconiah has been dishonored like a vessel for which there is no use, for he has been cast away and thrown out into a land that he did not know.
verses.22:29: O earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.22:30: "Write this man down as an outcast man, for none of his seed shall prosper, sitting on the throne of David, ruling anymore in Judah."
verses.23:1: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of their pasture!
verses.23:2: Therefore thus says the Lord against those who shepherd My people: "You have scattered My sheep and driven them away, and have not watched over them; behold, I am executing vengeance upon you according to your wicked practices.
verses.23:3: And I Myself will gather in the remnant of My people from across all the earth where I drove them, and I will restore them to their pasture, and they shall increase and be multiplied.
verses.23:4: And I will raise up shepherds for them who shall shepherd them; and they shall no longer fear nor be terrified," says the Lord.
verses.23:5: "Behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "when I will raise up for David a righteous Dayspring; and a King shall reign and have understanding, and shall execute judgment and righteousness upon the earth.
verses.23:6: In His days Judah also shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell in confidence; and this is His name which the Lord shall call Him: 'Josedek.'" Concerning the prophets.
verses.23:8: "And I will bring upon you an everlasting reproach and an everlasting dishonor, which shall not be forgotten. Therefore, behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "when they shall no longer say, 'The Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel out of the land of Egypt,' but, 'The Lord lives, who gathered all the seed of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where He had driven them, and restored them to their own land.'"
verses.23:9: My heart is broken within me; all my bones are shaken; I have become like a broken man, and like a man overcome by wine, because of the presence of the Lord and because of the presence of the splendor of His glory.
verses.23:10: For because of these the land has mourned; the pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their forest has become evil, and their strength likewise.
verses.23:11: "For both priest and prophet are defiled; even in My house I have seen their wicked deeds.
verses.23:12: Therefore let their way become to them a slippery place in thick darkness, and they shall be tripped up and fall in it; for I will bring calamities upon them in the year of their visitation.
verses.23:13: And among the prophets of Samaria I saw lawless deeds: they prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.
verses.23:14: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen horrible things: they commit adultery and walk in lies, and take hold of the hands of many, so that no one turns back from his wicked way. They have all become to Me like Sodom, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah."
verses.23:15: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will feed them anguish and give them bitter water to drink; for from the prophets of Jerusalem defilement has gone out into all the land."
verses.23:16: Thus says the Lord Almighty: "Do not listen to the words of the prophets, for they devise a vain vision for themselves; they speak from their own heart, and not from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.23:17: They say to those who reject the word of the Lord, 'You shall have peace'; and to all who walk in their own desires, to everyone who walks in the error of his heart, they have said, 'No evil shall come upon you.'
verses.23:18: For who has stood in the council of the Lord and seen His word? Who has given ear and heard?
verses.23:19: Behold, a tempest from the Lord, and wrath goes forth into a violent shaking; whirling, it shall come upon the ungodly,
verses.23:20: and the fury of the Lord shall no longer turn back, until He has accomplished it from the purpose of His heart. At the end of the days they shall understand it.
verses.23:21: I did not send the prophets, yet they ran; nor did I speak to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.23:22: And if they had stood in My council, and if they had heard My words, then they would have turned My people back from their wicked practices.
verses.23:23: I am a God who draws near, and not a God afar off.
verses.23:24: Shall anyone hide himself in secret places, and I shall not see him? Do I not fill heaven and earth?" says the Lord.
verses.23:25: "I have heard what the prophets speak; they prophesy lies in My name, saying, 'I have dreamed a dream.'
verses.23:26: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, while they prophesy the desires of their own heart,
verses.23:27: who scheme to forget My law by their dreams, which each one tells to his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name for Baal?
verses.23:28: The prophet in whom there is a dream, let him tell his dream; and he who has My word with him, let him declare My word in truth. What is the chaff to the wheat?
verses.23:29: So are My words," says the Lord. "Behold, are not My words like fire, and like an axe splitting rock?"
verses.23:30: "Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets," says the Lord God, "who steal My words, each one from his neighbor.
verses.23:31: Behold, I am against the prophets who put forth prophecies of the tongue and slumber their own slumber.
verses.23:32: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets who prophesy false dreams, and did not tell them, and led My people astray by their lies and by their deceits; yet I did not send them nor command them, and they shall not profit this people at all.
verses.23:33: And if this people, or a priest, or a prophet, asks you, 'What is the burden of the Lord?' then you shall say to them, 'You are the burden, and I will cast you down,'" says the Lord.
verses.23:34: "As for the prophet and the priests and the people who say, 'The burden of the Lord,' I will even bring vengeance upon that man and his house.
verses.23:35: Thus you shall say, each one to his neighbor and each one to his brother, 'What has the Lord answered? And what has the Lord spoken?'
verses.23:36: And 'The burden of the Lord' you shall mention no more, for his own word shall be a man's burden."
verses.23:37: And why has the Lord our God spoken?
verses.23:38: Therefore thus says the Lord our God: "Because you have spoken this word, 'The burden of the Lord,' when I sent to you, saying, 'You shall not say, The burden of the Lord'—
verses.23:39: therefore, behold, I am taking up and casting down both you and the city which I gave to you and to your fathers."
verses.24:1: The Lord showed me two baskets of figs set before the temple of the Lord, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried into exile Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the rulers, and the craftsmen, and the prisoners, and the neighbors from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.24:2: One basket had very good figs, like the early figs; and the other basket had very bad figs, which cannot be eaten because of their badness.
verses.24:3: Then the Lord said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "Figs: the good ones, exceedingly good, and the bad ones, exceedingly bad, which cannot be eaten because of their badness."
verses.24:4: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:5: Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: "Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge the exiled Judeans whom I have sent out from this place into the land of the Chaldeans for good.
verses.24:6: And I will fix My eyes upon them for good, and I will restore them to this land for good; and I will build them up and will by no means tear them down, and I will plant them and will by no means pluck them up.
verses.24:7: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God, for they shall return to Me with all their heart.
verses.24:8: And like the bad figs which cannot be eaten because of their badness"—thus says the Lord—"so will I hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, and his nobles, and the remnant of Jerusalem, those who remain in this land and those who dwell in Egypt.
verses.24:9: And I will deliver them over to dispersion into all the kingdoms of the earth, and to reproach, and to a byword, and to hatred, and to a curse in every place where I have driven them;
verses.24:10: and I will send among them famine, and death, and the sword, until they perish from the land which I gave to them."
verses.25:1: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah,
verses.25:2: which he spoke to all the people of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
verses.25:3: "In the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amos, king of Judah, even to this day—twenty-three years—I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking.
verses.25:4: And I sent to you My servants the prophets, sending them early in the morning, yet you did not listen nor incline your ears,
verses.25:5: saying, 'Turn back, each one from his wicked way and from your wicked practices, and you shall dwell upon the land which I gave to you and to your fathers from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.25:6: Do not walk after foreign gods to serve them and to worship them, so that you do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands, to bring harm upon yourselves.'
verses.25:7: Yet you did not listen to Me.
verses.25:8: Therefore thus says the Lord: 'Because you have not believed My words,
verses.25:9: behold, I am sending, and I will take a family from the north, and I will bring them against this land and against its inhabitants and against all the nations round about it; and I will lay them waste and give them over to desolation, and to hissing, and to everlasting reproach.
verses.25:10: And I will destroy from among them the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the fragrance of ointment and the light of the lamp.
verses.25:11: And all the land shall become a desolation, and they shall serve among the nations seventy years.
verses.25:12: And when seventy years are fulfilled, I will execute vengeance upon that nation and will make them an everlasting desolation,
verses.25:13: and I will bring upon that land all My words which I have spoken against it, even all that is written in this book.'"
verses.25:14: The things which Jeremiah prophesied against the nations; those concerning Elam: In the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah, this word came concerning Elam.
verses.25:15: Thus says the Lord: "The bow of Elam is broken, the chief of their might.
verses.25:16: And I will bring upon Elam four winds from the four ends of heaven, and I will scatter them to all these winds; and there shall be no nation to which the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.25:17: And I will terrify them before their enemies who seek their life, and I will bring upon them according to the wrath of My fury, and I will send My sword after them until I have utterly consumed them.
verses.25:18: And I will set My throne in Elam, and I will send away from there king and nobles;
verses.25:19: and it shall come to pass at the end of the days that I will turn back the captivity of Elam," says the Lord.
verses.26:2: Concerning Egypt: against the army of Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, who was by the river Euphrates at Charmeis, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck down in the fourth year of Jehoiakim king of Judah.
verses.26:3: Take up weapons and shields, and draw near to battle.
verses.26:4: And saddle the horses; mount up, O horsemen, and take your stand in your helmets; thrust forward the spears and put on your breastplates.
verses.26:5: Why is it that they are terrified and retreat backward? For their mighty men shall be cut down; in flight they fled and did not turn back, surrounded on every side, says the Lord.
verses.26:6: Do not let the swift flee, and do not let the mighty man escape toward the north; those beside the Euphrates have grown weak, and they have fallen.
verses.26:7: Who is this who shall rise up like a river, and as rivers surge with water?
verses.26:8: The waters of Egypt shall rise up like a river, and it said, "I will rise up and cover the earth, and I will destroy those who dwell in it."
verses.26:9: Mount the horses, prepare the chariots; come forth, O warriors of the Ethiopians, and Libyans fully armed with weapons, and Lydians, go up, bend the bow.
verses.26:10: And that day belongs to the Lord our God, a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on His enemies; and the sword of the Lord shall devour, and it shall be filled and become drunk from their blood; for there is a sacrifice for the Lord from the land of the north by the river Euphrates.
verses.26:11: Go up, O Gilead, and take balm for the virgin daughter of Egypt; in vain you have multiplied your remedies; there is no benefit for you.
verses.26:12: The nations have heard your voice, and the earth has been filled with your outcry; for warrior has weakened against warrior, and both have fallen together.
verses.26:13: The things which the Lord spoke by the hand of Jeremiah concerning the coming of the king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt.
verses.26:14: Declare it in Migdol, and proclaim it in Memphis; say, "Take your stand and prepare, for a sword has devoured your bindweed."
verses.26:15: Why has Apis fled from you? Your chosen calf did not remain, because the Lord has weakened him.
verses.26:16: And your multitude grew weak and fell, and each one spoke to his neighbor, "Let us arise and return to our people, to our homeland, from the face of the Greek sword."
verses.26:17: Call the name of Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, "Saon Esbei Emoed."
verses.26:18: "As I live," says the Lord God, "like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel by the sea, he shall come."
verses.26:19: Prepare for yourself baggage for exile, O daughter who dwells in Egypt; for Memphis shall become a desolation, and she shall be called "Woe," because there are none who dwell in her.
verses.26:20: Egypt is a beautified heifer; a detachment from the north has come upon her,
verses.26:21: and her hired soldiers in her midst are like fattened calves fed within her; for they also have turned back and fled with one accord; they did not stand, because the day of destruction has come upon them, and the time of their vengeance.
verses.26:22: A sound like a hissing serpent, for they march in the sand; with axes they shall come against her.
verses.26:23: Like men cutting timber, they shall cut down her forest, says the Lord, for it cannot be fathomed, because it multiplies beyond the locust, and they are without number.
verses.26:24: The daughter of Egypt has been put to shame; she has been delivered into the hands of a people from the north.
verses.26:25: Behold, I am taking vengeance on Ammon her son, on Pharaoh, and on those who trust in him.
verses.26:27: But do not fear, My servant Jacob, and do not be dismayed, O Israel; for behold, I am saving you from afar, and your seed from their captivity; and Jacob shall return and be at rest and sleep, and there shall be no one who troubles him.
verses.26:28: Do not fear, My servant Jacob, says the Lord, for I am with you. The fearless and delicate one has been delivered up; for I will make a complete end among all those to whom I have driven you out there, yet I will by no means cause you to come to an end; and I will chasten you in judgment, and will by no means hold you guiltless.
verses.27:1: The word of the Lord which He spoke against Babylon.
verses.27:2: Declare among the nations and make it heard, and do not conceal it; say, "Babylon has been captured; Bel, the fearless one, has been put to shame; the delicate one, Maiodak, has been delivered up."
verses.27:3: For a nation has come up against her from the north; this one shall make her land a desolation, and there shall be no one who dwells in it, from man even to beast.
verses.27:4: In those days and in that time, the sons of Israel shall come, they and the sons of Judah together; walking and weeping they shall go, seeking the Lord their God.
verses.27:5: They shall ask the way to Zion, for toward this place they shall set their face; and they shall come and take refuge in the Lord God, for an everlasting covenant shall not be forgotten.
verses.27:6: My people have become lost sheep; their shepherds have driven them out, upon the mountains they have led them astray; from mountain to hill they have gone, they have forgotten their resting place.
verses.27:7: All who found them consumed them; their enemies said, "Let us not release them, because they have sinned against the Lord." A pasture of righteousness belongs to Him who gathered their fathers.
verses.27:8: Estrange yourselves from the midst of Babylon and from the land of the Chaldeans, and go forth, and become like dragons before the sheep.
verses.27:9: For behold, I am stirring up against Babylon assemblies of nations from the land of the north, and they shall array themselves against her; from there she shall be captured. Like the dart of a skilled warrior, it shall not return empty.
verses.27:10: And Chaldea shall become a spoil; all who plunder her shall be filled.
verses.27:11: Because you rejoiced and boasted while plundering My inheritance, because you leaped like calves in the grass and butted with horns like bulls.
verses.27:12: Your mother has been greatly put to shame, a mother for good things, the last of the nations, a wilderness.
verses.27:13: Because of the wrath of the Lord she shall not be inhabited, and she shall become wholly a desolation; and everyone who passes through Babylon shall look gloomy, and they shall hiss at all her plague.
verses.27:14: Array yourselves against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot arrows at her, do not spare your arrows.
verses.27:15: And prevail over her; her hands have grown limp, her battlements have fallen, and her wall has been torn down; for it is vengeance from God. Take vengeance upon her; as she has done, do to her.
verses.27:16: Utterly destroy the seed from Babylon, the one holding a sickle in the time of harvest; from the face of the Greek sword each one shall turn back to his people, and each one shall flee to his own land.
verses.27:17: Israel is a straying sheep; lions have driven him out. First the king of Assyria devoured him, and afterward this one, the king of Babylon, devoured his bones.
verses.27:18: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I am executing vengeance upon him of Babylon and upon his land, just as I executed vengeance upon the king of Assyria.
verses.27:19: And I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and on Mount Ephraim and in Gilead, and his soul shall be filled.
verses.27:20: In those days and in that time, they shall seek the iniquity of Israel, and it shall not exist, and the sins of Judah, and they shall by no means be found; for I will be merciful to those who remain upon the earth," says the Lord.
verses.27:21: "Bitterly go up against her, and against those who dwell upon her; take vengeance, O sword, and destroy," says the Lord, "and do according to all that I command you."
verses.27:22: A sound of battle and great destruction is in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.27:23: How has the hammer of all the earth been broken and shattered? How has Babylon become a desolation among the nations?
verses.27:24: They shall come upon you, and you shall not know it, like Babylon, and you shall be captured; you have been found and seized, because you withstood the Lord.
verses.27:25: The Lord has opened His treasury and has brought forth the weapons of His wrath; for there is a work for the Lord God in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.27:26: For her times have come. Open her storehouses, search her like a cave, and utterly destroy her; let there be no remnant of her.
verses.27:27: Dry up all her fruits, and let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, and the time of their vengeance.
verses.27:28: The voice of those who flee and escape from the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance from the Lord our God.
verses.27:29: Summon many against Babylon, everyone who bends the bow; encamp against her all around; let no one of hers escape; repay her according to her works; according to all that she has done, do to her, for she has withstood the Lord, the Holy God of Israel.
verses.27:30: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all her men of war shall be cast down, said the Lord.
verses.27:31: Behold, I am against you, O insolent one, says the Lord, for your day has come, and the time of your vengeance.
verses.27:32: And your insolence shall grow weak and fall, and there shall be no one who raises her up; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is around her.
verses.27:33: Thus says the Lord: "The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have been oppressed; together all those who took them captive have oppressed them, because they were unwilling to send them away.
verses.27:34: Yet He who redeems them is strong; the Lord Almighty is His name. He shall execute judgment against His adversaries, so that He may remove the earth and provoke those who dwell in Babylon."
verses.27:35: A sword against the Chaldeans, and against those who dwell in Babylon, and against her nobles, and against her wise men.
verses.27:36: A sword against her warriors, and they shall be weakened; a sword against their horses and against their chariots.
verses.27:37: A sword against their warriors and against the mixed multitude in her midst, and they shall become like women; a sword against her treasures, and they shall be scattered
verses.27:38: upon her water, and they shall be put to shame; for it is a land of carved images, and in the islands where they boasted.
verses.27:39: Therefore phantoms shall dwell in the islands, and daughters of sirens shall dwell in her; she shall no longer be inhabited forever.
verses.27:40: Just as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and those bordering them, said the Lord, no man shall dwell there, and no son of man shall sojourn there.
verses.27:41: Behold, a people is coming from the north, and a great nation and many kings shall be stirred up from the farthest part of the earth,
verses.27:42: holding bow and dagger; it is fierce, and shall show no mercy; their voice shall roar like the sea; they shall ride on horses, arrayed like fire for battle, against you, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.27:43: The king of Babylon heard the report of them, and his hands grew limp; anguish took hold of him, pangs like those of a woman in labor.
verses.27:44: Behold, like a lion he shall come up from the Jordan to Gaithan; for I will swiftly drive them away from her, and I will appoint every young man over her. For who is like Me? And who shall withstand Me? And who is this shepherd who shall stand before My face?
verses.27:45: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord which He has purposed against Babylon, and His designs which He has devised against the Chaldeans who dwell there: surely the lambs of their sheep shall be destroyed; surely pasture shall be laid waste from them.
verses.27:46: For at the sound of the capture of Babylon the earth shall be shaken, and an outcry shall be heard among the nations.
verses.28:1: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I am raising up against Babylon and against the Chaldean inhabitants a scorching, destroying wind.
verses.28:2: And I will send forth into Babylon insolent men, and they shall deal insolently with her and ravage her land; woe upon Babylon on every side in the day of her affliction!
verses.28:3: Let him who bends his bow bend it, and let him who has his armor put it on; and do not spare her young men, and utterly destroy all her host.
verses.28:4: And the wounded shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and those pierced through outside of her.
verses.28:5: For Israel and Judah have not been widowed from their God, from the Lord Almighty, because their land has been filled with unrighteousness from the holy ones of Israel.
verses.28:6: Flee from the midst of Babylon, and save each one his own life, and do not be cast away in her iniquity; for it is the time of her vengeance from the Lord; He Himself is rendering recompense to her.
verses.28:7: Babylon was a golden cup in the hand of the Lord, making all the earth drunk; the nations drank of her wine, therefore they were shaken.
verses.28:8: And suddenly Babylon has fallen and been shattered. Lament over her; take balm for her ruin, if perhaps she may be healed."
verses.28:9: "We treated Babylon, and she was not healed; let us forsake her, and let us depart, each one to his own land; for her judgment has reached to heaven; it has risen even to the stars."
verses.28:10: "The Lord has brought forth His judgment; come, and let us declare in Zion the works of the Lord our God."
verses.28:11: Prepare the arrows, fill the quivers! The Lord has stirred up the spirit of the king of the Medes, for His wrath is against Babylon, to utterly destroy her; for it is the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of His people.
verses.28:12: Lift up a banner upon the walls of Babylon, set up the quivers, rouse the watches, make ready the weapons; for He has taken it in hand, and the Lord will perform what He has spoken against the inhabitants of Babylon,
verses.28:13: who dwell upon many waters and upon the abundance of her treasures. Your end has truly come into your inward parts.
verses.28:14: For the Lord has sworn by His arm: "Surely I will fill you with men as with locusts, and those who descend shall shout against you."
verses.28:15: He who makes the earth by His strength, who prepares the inhabited world by His wisdom, by His understanding stretched out the heaven;
verses.28:16: at a voice He placed a roar of water in the heaven, and brought up clouds from the end of the earth; He made lightnings for the rain, and brought forth light out of His treasuries.
verses.28:17: Every man has become foolish without knowledge; every goldsmith has been put to shame by his carved images, for they have cast false things; there is no breath in them.
verses.28:18: They are futile things, works of mockery; in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.28:19: Such is not the portion of Jacob, for He who formed all things, He Himself is his inheritance; the Lord is His name.
verses.28:20: "You scatter for Me weapons of war, and with you I will scatter nations, and from you I will remove kings.
verses.28:21: And with you I will scatter the horse and its rider,
verses.28:22: and with you I will scatter chariots and their riders; and with you I will scatter young man and virgin, and with you I will scatter man and woman.
verses.28:23: And with you I will scatter the shepherd and his flock, and with you I will scatter the farmer and his tilled field, and with you I will scatter your governors and commanders.
verses.28:24: And I will repay Babylon and all the Chaldean inhabitants for all their evils which they committed against Zion before your eyes," says the Lord.
verses.28:25: "Behold, I am against you, O corrupted mountain that destroys all the earth; and I will stretch out My hand against you, and roll you down upon the rocks, and make you like a burned mountain.
verses.28:26: And they shall by no means take from you a stone for a corner, nor a stone for a foundation; for you shall be an utter desolation forever," says the Lord.
verses.28:27: "Lift up a banner upon the earth, sound the trumpet among the nations! Consecrate nations against her; give orders against her—raise up kings from Me—and to the Ashkenazites; set up siege engines against her; bring up horses against her like a multitude of locusts.
verses.28:28: Bring up nations against her, the king of the Medes and of all the earth, his governors and all his commanders."
verses.28:29: The earth shook and writhed in pain, because the purpose of the Lord has risen up against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon an utter desolation, so that it shall not be inhabited.
verses.28:30: The warrior of Babylon has ceased from fighting; they shall sit there under siege; their might has been broken, they have become like women; her dwellings have been set on fire, her bars have been shattered.
verses.28:31: Runner shall run to meet runner, and messenger to meet messenger, to report to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured,
verses.28:32: from the end of his passages they have been seized, and they have burned their reservoirs with fire, and his men of war are going forth.
verses.28:33: For thus says the Lord: "The houses of the king of Babylon shall be threshed like a threshing floor in season; yet a little while, and her harvest shall come."
verses.28:34: "He has devoured me, he has divided me, a thin darkness has overtaken me; Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has swallowed me up; like a dragon he has filled his belly from my delicacies.
verses.28:35: My toils and my miseries have thrust me out into Babylon," the inhabitant of Zion shall say; "and my blood be upon the Chaldean inhabitants," Jerusalem shall say.
verses.28:36: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will judge your adversary and execute your vengeance; and I will lay waste her sea and dry up her spring.
verses.28:37: And Babylon shall become an utter desolation, and shall not be inhabited.
verses.28:38: For together like lions they have risen up, and like lions' cubs.
verses.28:39: In their heat I will give them a drink, and I will make them drunk, so that they may become stupefied and sleep a perpetual sleep, and by no means awake," says the Lord.
verses.28:40: And bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, and like rams with young goats.
verses.28:41: How has the boast of all the earth been captured and hunted down? How has Babylon become an utter desolation among the nations?
verses.28:42: The sea has come up over Babylon with the roar of its waves, and she has been covered.
verses.28:43: Her cities have become like a waterless and untrodden land; not even one shall dwell in it, nor shall any son of man lodge in it.
verses.28:44: "And I will execute vengeance upon Babylon, and I will bring out of her mouth what she has swallowed; and the nations shall by no means be gathered together to her anymore,
verses.28:49: and in Babylon the wounded of all the earth shall fall."
verses.28:50: You who escape from the land, go and do not stand still! You who are from afar, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem come into your heart.
verses.28:51: "We have been put to shame, because we have heard our reproach; dishonor has covered our face; foreigners have entered into our sanctuaries, into the house of the Lord."
verses.28:52: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will execute vengeance upon her carved images, and in all her land the wounded shall fall.
verses.28:53: For though Babylon should ascend like heaven, and though she should fortify the walls with her strength, from Me those who utterly destroy her shall come," says the Lord.
verses.28:54: The sound of a cry is in Babylon, and great destruction in the land of the Chaldeans,
verses.28:55: because the Lord has utterly destroyed Babylon, and has destroyed from her a great voice roaring like many waters; He has given her voice over to destruction.
verses.28:56: For misery has come upon Babylon; her warriors have been captured, their bow is dismayed, for God is repaying them.
verses.28:57: The Lord is repaying, and He will make her governors, and her wise men, and her commanders drunk with intoxication, says the King; the Lord Almighty is His name.
verses.28:58: Thus says the Lord: "The wall of Babylon was made broad; it shall be utterly razed, and her lofty gates shall be set on fire; and peoples shall not labor in vain, and nations shall fail in the beginning."
verses.28:59: The word which the Lord commanded Jeremiah the prophet to speak to Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went from Zedekiah king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief of the gifts.
verses.28:60: And Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evils that should come upon Babylon, all these words that have been written against Babylon.
verses.28:61: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, "When you come to Babylon, then you shall see and read all these words,
verses.28:62: and you shall say, 'O Lord, Lord, You have spoken against this place to utterly destroy it, and that there should be no inhabitants in it, from man to beast, for it shall be an utter desolation forever.'
verses.28:63: And it shall be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall tie a stone to it and cast it into the midst of the Euphrates,
verses.28:64: and you shall say, 'Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall by no means rise again from the face of the Chaldeans whom I am bringing upon her.'"
verses.29:1: Against the Philistines. Thus says the Lord:
verses.29:2: "Behold, waters rise up from the north and shall become an overflowing torrent; it shall flood the land and its fullness, the city and those who dwell in it. Men shall cry out, and all who inhabit the land shall wail,
verses.29:3: at the sound of his rushing charge, at the hooves of his feet, and at the shaking of his chariots, the roaring of his wheels. Fathers have not turned back for their sons because of the feebleness of their hands,
verses.29:4: in the day that is coming to destroy all the Philistines. And I will wipe out Tyre and Sidon and all the remnant of their help, for the Lord will utterly destroy the remnant of the islands.
verses.29:5: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon has been cast away, and the remnant of the Anakim."
verses.29:6: How long will you strike, O sword of the Lord? How long will you not be quiet? Return into your scabbard; rest, and be lifted up.
verses.29:7: How shall it be quiet, when the Lord has commanded it to rise up against Ashkelon and against the coastal regions, against those that remain?
verses.30:1: Concerning Idumea. Thus says the Lord: "There is no longer wisdom in Teman; counsel has perished from the prudent; their wisdom has vanished,
verses.30:2: their place has been deceived. Go deep to dwell, O inhabitants of Dedan, for he has done grievous things; I have brought them upon him in the time when I visited him.
verses.30:3: For grape gatherers have come who shall not leave you a remnant; like thieves in the night they shall put forth their hand.
verses.30:4: For I have stripped Esau bare; I have uncovered their hidden places, and they shall by no means be able to hide themselves. They have perished by the hand of his brother, My neighbor, and there is no one
verses.30:5: to leave your fatherless child behind that he may live; yet I shall live, and widows have trusted in Me."
verses.30:6: For thus says the Lord: "Those for whom there was no law to drink the cup have drunk it; and you shall by no means be held guiltless,
verses.30:7: for I have sworn by Myself," says the Lord, "that you shall become an untrodden waste, and a reproach, and a curse in the midst of her, and all her cities shall be desolate forever."
verses.30:8: I have heard a report from the Lord, and He has sent messengers to the nations: "Gather together and come against her; rise up to battle!"
verses.30:9: "I have made you small among the nations, despised among men.
verses.30:10: Your mockery has set upon you; the audacity of your heart has taken up lodging in the clefts of the rocks and laid hold of the strength of a lofty hill. Because he has exalted his nest like an eagle, from there I will bring you down."
verses.30:11: And Idumea shall become an untrodden waste; everyone who passes by her shall hiss.
verses.30:12: "As Sodom and Gomorrah and her neighboring cities were overthrown," says the Lord Almighty, "no man shall settle there, nor shall a son of man dwell there.
verses.30:13: Behold, like a lion he shall come up from the midst of the Jordan to the place of Etham, for I will swiftly drive them out from her; and appoint the young men over her! For who is like Me? And who shall withstand Me? And who is this shepherd who shall stand before My face?"
verses.30:14: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord which He has counseled against Idumea, and His design which He has devised against those who dwell in Teman: "Surely the least of the sheep shall be swept away; surely their habitation shall be made an untrodden waste against her."
verses.30:15: For at the sound of their fall the earth was afraid, and the cry of the sea was not heard.
verses.30:16: Behold, like an eagle he shall look down and spread out his wings over her strongholds; and the heart of the mighty men of Idumea in that day shall be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.30:17: Concerning the sons of Ammon. Thus says the Lord: "Are there no sons in Israel, or is there no heir for them? Why has Melchol taken possession of Gilead, and why shall their people dwell in their cities?
verses.30:18: Therefore, behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "when I will cause the tumult of wars to be heard against Rabbah; and they shall become an untrodden waste and a ruin, and her altars shall be burned up with fire, and Israel shall take possession of his dominion.
verses.30:19: Wail, O Heshbon, for she has perished! Cry out, O daughters of Rabbah; gird yourselves with sackcloth and lament, for Melchol shall go into captivity, his priests and his rulers together.
verses.30:20: Why do you exult in the plains of the Anakim, O daughter of audacity, who trusts in her treasures, who says, 'Who shall come in against me?'
verses.30:21: Behold, I am bringing terror upon you," says the Lord, "from all the region round about you; and you shall be scattered, each man before his face, and there is no one who gathers."
verses.30:23: Concerning Kedar, queen of the court, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck. Thus says the Lord: "Arise and go up against Kedar, and fill the sons of Kedem.
verses.30:24: Their tents and their sheep they shall take; their garments and all their vessels and their camels they shall take for themselves; and call out destruction upon them from every side.
verses.30:25: Flee! You have gone very deep to dwell, you who sit in the court, for the king of Babylon has counseled a counsel against you and has devised a plan.
verses.30:26: Arise and go up against a tranquil nation, dwelling at ease, that has no doors, no bolts, no bars; they dwell alone.
verses.30:27: And their camels shall become plunder, and the multitude of their livestock destruction; and I will winnow them to every wind, those who are shorn before their face; from every region beyond them I will bring their rout," says the Lord.
verses.30:28: "And the court shall become a haunt of ostriches and an untrodden waste forever; no man shall dwell there, and no son of man shall inhabit it."
verses.30:29: Concerning Damascus. Themar and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard an evil report; they are dismayed, they are enraged; they shall by no means be able to rest.
verses.30:30: Damascus has grown faint; she has turned to flee; trembling has seized her.
verses.30:31: "How has she not forsaken My city? They have loved a village.
verses.30:32: Therefore young men shall fall in your broad streets, and all your men of war shall fall," says the Lord,
verses.30:33: "and I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the quarters of the son of Hader."
verses.31:1: Concerning Moab. Thus says the Lord: "Woe to Nebo, for it has perished! Kiriathaim is captured; Hamath and Agath are put to shame.
verses.31:2: There is no longer healing for Moab, nor boasting in Heshbon; he has devised evil against her; we have cut her off from being a nation, and she shall utterly cease. Behind you a sword shall march,
verses.31:3: for there is the sound of those crying out from Horonaim, destruction and a great shattering.
verses.31:4: Moab is shattered! Proclaim it to Zogora,
verses.31:5: for Aloth is filled with weeping; weeping, he shall go up by the way of Horonaim; you have heard the outcry of shattering.
verses.31:6: Flee and save your lives, and become like a wild donkey in the wilderness.
verses.31:7: Because you trusted in your strongholds, you also shall be captured; and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his rulers together."
verses.31:8: And destruction shall come upon every city—it shall by no means be saved—and the valley shall perish, and the plain shall be utterly destroyed, just as the Lord has spoken.
verses.31:9: Give signs to Moab, for she shall surely be kindled, and all her cities shall become an untrodden waste; where shall an inhabitant come from for her?
verses.31:10: Cursed is the one who does the works of the Lord negligently, withholding his sword from blood.
verses.31:11: Moab has been at rest from his childhood, and he has been confident in his glory; he has not poured from vessel to vessel, nor has he gone into exile; therefore his taste has remained in him, and his scent has not faded.
verses.31:12: "Therefore, behold, his days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will send tilters to him, and they shall tilt him, and crush his vessels to pieces, and shatter his horns;
verses.31:13: and Moab shall be put to shame because of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was put to shame because of Bethel, their hope, having trusted in them.
verses.31:14: How will you say, 'We are mighty, and a man strong for matters of war'?
verses.31:15: Moab—his city—has perished, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter.
verses.31:16: The day of Moab is near to come, and his calamity is exceedingly swift.
verses.31:17: Mourn for him, all you around him; all of you, proclaim his name; say, 'How the glorious staff is broken, the rod of magnificence!'
verses.31:18: Come down from glory and sit in dampness, O you who dwell there! Dibon is obliterated, for Moab has perished; he who ravages your stronghold has come up against you.
verses.31:19: Stand by the way and watch, O you who dwell in Aroer; ask the one who flees and the one who escapes, and say, 'What has happened?'
verses.31:20: Moab is put to shame, for it is shattered! Wail and cry out; proclaim in Arnon that Moab has perished,
verses.31:21: and judgment comes to the land of Meisor: upon Chailon, and Rephas, and Mophas,
verses.31:22: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon the house of Diblathaim,
verses.31:23: and upon Kiriathaim, and upon the house of Gamul, and upon the house of Maon,
verses.31:24: and upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of Moab, those far off and those near.
verses.31:25: The horn of Moab is broken, and his arm is shattered.
verses.31:26: Make him drunk, for he has magnified himself against the Lord; and Moab shall strike with his hand, and he himself also shall become an object of laughter.
verses.31:27: And was he not a derision to you, O Israel, and was he found among your thefts, that you waged war against him?
verses.31:28: The inhabitants of Moab have forsaken the cities and dwelt in the rocks; they have become like doves nesting in the rocks at the mouth of a pit.
verses.31:29: And I have heard of the arrogance of Moab—he has been exceedingly arrogant—his arrogance and his haughtiness, and his heart has been lifted up;
verses.31:30: yet I have known his deeds. Is it not enough for him? Has he not done thus?
verses.31:31: Therefore wail over Moab on every side; cry out over the men of Keir Hadas of drought.
verses.31:32: As with the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, O vine of Oserema! Your branches crossed the sea; the cities of Jazer touched upon your summer fruit; upon your grape-gatherers destruction has fallen.
verses.31:33: Joy and gladness have been swept away from the land of Moab, and wine was in your winepresses; in the morning they did not tread, nor at dusk did these do so.
verses.31:34: From the outcry of Heshbon as far as Aitam, their cities have given forth their voice, from Zogor as far as Horonaim, and the report of Salaseia; for even the water of Nebrein shall become a burning.
verses.31:35: And I will destroy Moab," says the Lord, "as he goes up to the altar and burns incense to his gods.
verses.31:36: Therefore the heart of Moab shall moan like flutes; My heart shall moan like a flute for the shorn men; therefore the things he acquired have perished from man.
verses.31:37: They shall be shaved on every head in every place, and every beard shall be shaved, and all hands shall beat in mourning, and upon every loin shall be sackcloth.
verses.31:38: And upon all the housetops of Moab and in her streets—for I have shattered it," says the Lord, "like a vessel for which there is no use.
verses.31:39: How it has changed! How Moab has turned the back! He is put to shame, and Moab has become an object of laughter and resentment to all those around her."
verses.31:41: "Ekron is captured, and the strongholds are seized,
verses.31:42: and Moab shall perish from being a multitude, because he has magnified himself against the Lord.
verses.31:43: Snare and terror and pit are upon you, O inhabitant of Moab.
verses.31:44: He who flees from the face of terror shall fall into the pit, and he who climbs up out of the pit shall be caught in the snare; for I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of their visitation."
verses.32:15: Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: "Take this cup of unmixed wine from My hand, and you shall make all the nations drink, to which I send you;
verses.32:16: and they shall vomit, and be driven mad from the face of the sword which I send among them."
verses.32:17: So I took the cup from the hand of the Lord, and made the nations drink, to which the Lord sent me:
verses.32:18: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, and the kings of Judah and its rulers, to make them a desolation, and an untrodden waste, and a hissing;
verses.32:19: and Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his nobles,
verses.32:20: and all his people, and all the mixed peoples, and all the kings of the Philistines—Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
verses.32:21: and Edom, and the land of Moab, and the sons of Ammon;
verses.32:22: and the kings of Tyre, and the kings of Sidon, and the kings who are across the sea;
verses.32:23: and Dedan, and Tema, and Rhos, and every one who is clipped around his face;
verses.32:24: and all the mixed peoples who lodge in the wilderness;
verses.32:25: and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Persians;
verses.32:26: and all the kings from the east, those far off and those near, each one with his brother, and all the kingdoms that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.32:27: And you shall say to them, "Thus says the Lord Almighty: 'Drink, be drunk, and you shall vomit and fall, and by no means rise from the face of the sword which I send among you.'"
verses.32:28: And it shall be, when they are unwilling to receive the cup from your hand to drink, that you shall say, "Thus says the Lord: 'You shall surely drink!
verses.32:29: For in the city upon which My name has been called I begin to bring calamity, and you shall by no means be acquitted; for I summon a sword upon those who dwell upon the earth.'"
verses.32:30: And you shall prophesy against them these words, and you shall say: "The Lord shall utter an oracle from on high; from His holy place He shall give forth His voice; He shall proclaim a word over His place, and these shall answer like grape-gatherers. And upon those who dwell on the earth destruction comes,
verses.32:31: to a part of the earth, for the Lord has a judgment among the nations; He Himself enters into judgment with all flesh, and the ungodly have been given over to the sword, says the Lord."
verses.32:32: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, evils are coming from nation to nation, and a great tempest goes forth from the end of the earth;
verses.32:33: and those slain by the Lord in the day of the Lord shall be from one part of the earth even to another part of the earth; they shall by no means be buried; they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.32:34: Wail, you shepherds, and cry out, and beat yourselves in mourning, you rams of the sheep! For your days for slaughter have been fulfilled, and you shall fall like the chosen rams;
verses.32:35: and flight shall perish from the shepherds, and deliverance from the rams of the sheep.
verses.32:36: A voice of the outcry of the shepherds, and a wailing of the sheep and of the rams! For the Lord has destroyed their pastures,
verses.32:37: and the remnants of peace shall cease from the face of the wrath of My anger.
verses.32:38: He has forsaken His lair like a lion, for their land has become an untrodden waste from the face of the great sword."
verses.33:1: In the beginning of King Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, this word came from the Lord.
verses.33:2: Thus says the Lord: "Stand in the court of the house of the Lord, and you shall proclaim to all the Judeans and to all who come to worship in the house of the Lord all the words that I have commanded you to proclaim to them; do not take away a word.
verses.33:3: Perhaps they will listen and turn back, each one from his evil way, and I will cease from the evils that I purpose to do to them on account of their evil practices.
verses.33:4: And you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: If you do not listen to Me, to walk in My statutes which I have set before your face,
verses.33:5: to heed the words of My servants the prophets, whom I send to you early in the morning—and I sent them, yet you did not listen to Me—
verses.33:6: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make the city a curse to all the nations of all the earth.'"
verses.33:7: And the priests and the false prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
verses.33:8: And it came to pass, when Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the false prophets and all the people seized him, saying, "You shall surely die,
verses.33:9: for you have prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, 'This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be made desolate, without inhabitants.'" And all the people were assembled against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
verses.33:10: And the rulers of Judah heard this word, and they went up from the house of the king to the house of the Lord, and sat down at the entrance of the New Gate.
verses.33:11: And the priests and the false prophets spoke to the rulers and to all the people: "A judgment of death is due this man, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears."
verses.33:12: And Jeremiah spoke to the rulers and to all the people, saying, "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.33:13: And now amend your ways and your deeds, and listen to the voice of the Lord, and the Lord will cease from the evils that He has spoken against you.
verses.33:14: And behold, I am in your hands; do to me as is fitting and as is better for you.
verses.33:15: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you bring innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and upon those who dwell in it; for in truth the Lord has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears."
verses.33:16: And the rulers and all the people said to the priests and to the false prophets, "No judgment of death is due this man, for in the name of the Lord our God he has spoken to us."
verses.33:17: And certain men of the elders of the land rose up and spoke to the whole assembly of the people,
verses.33:18: "Micah the Morasthite lived in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and spoke to all the people of Judah, 'Thus says the Lord: Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become an untrodden waste, and the mountain of the house a grove of the forest.'
verses.33:19: Did Hezekiah and all Judah put him to death at all? Was it not that they feared the Lord, and made supplication before the face of the Lord, and the Lord ceased from the evils that He had spoken against them? Yet we have committed great evils against our own souls."
verses.33:20: There was also a man prophesying in the name of the Lord, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim, and he prophesied concerning this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.33:21: And King Jehoiakim and all the rulers heard all his words, and they sought to kill him; and Uriah heard of it and went into Egypt.
verses.33:22: And the king sent men into Egypt,
verses.33:23: and they brought him out from there and brought him in to the king; and he struck him with the sword and cast him into the tomb of the sons of his people.
verses.33:24: Nevertheless, the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they did not deliver him into the hands of the people to put him to death.
verses.34:2: Thus says the Lord: "Make bonds and yoke-bars, and put them around your neck,
verses.34:3: and you shall send them to the king of Idumea, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the sons of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hands of their messengers who come to meet them in Jerusalem, to Zedekiah, king of Judah.
verses.34:4: And you shall command them to say to their masters, 'Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: Thus you shall say to your masters:
verses.34:5: I have made the earth by My great strength and by My uplifted arm, and I will give it to whomever it seems good in My eyes.
verses.34:6: I have given the earth to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, to serve him, and the wild beasts of the field to labor for him.
verses.34:8: And whatever nation and kingdom will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will visit them with sword and with famine, says the Lord, until they perish by his hand.
verses.34:9: And as for you, do not listen to your false prophets, nor to those who divine for you, nor to those who dream for you, nor to your omens, nor to your sorcerers, who say, "You shall by no means serve the king of Babylon,"
verses.34:10: for they prophesy lies to you, so as to remove you far from your land.
verses.34:11: And the nation that brings its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will leave it upon its own land; and it shall serve him and dwell in it.'"
verses.34:12: And to Zedekiah, king of Judah, I spoke according to all these words, saying, "Bring your neck and serve the king of Babylon.
verses.34:14: For they prophesy unjust things to you,
verses.34:15: for I have not sent them, says the Lord, yet they prophesy in My name unjustly, so as to destroy you; and you shall perish, both you and your prophets who prophesy lies to you unjustly."
verses.34:16: To you and to all this people and to the priests I spoke, saying, "Thus says the Lord: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you, saying, 'Behold, the vessels of the house of the Lord shall return from Babylon,' for they prophesy unjust things to you; I have not sent them.
verses.34:18: If they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is in them, let them meet Me;
verses.34:19: for thus says the Lord: Even concerning the remaining vessels,
verses.34:20: which the king of Babylon did not take when he led Jeconiah into exile from Jerusalem,
verses.34:22: they shall enter into Babylon, says the Lord."
verses.35:1: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Zedekiah, king of Judah, in the fifth month, that Hananiah son of Azzur, the false prophet from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord in the sight of the priests and all the people, saying,
verses.35:2: "Thus says the Lord: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.35:3: Yet two years of days, and I will bring back to this place the vessels of the house of the Lord,
verses.35:4: and Jeconiah and the exiles of Judah; for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon."
verses.35:5: And Jeremiah spoke to Hananiah in the sight of all the people and in the sight of the priests who stood in the house of the Lord;
verses.35:6: and Jeremiah said, "Truly, may the Lord do so! May He establish your word which you prophesy, to bring back the vessels of the house of the Lord and all the exiles from Babylon to this place.
verses.35:7: Nevertheless, hear the word of the Lord that I speak in your ears and in the ears of all the people:
verses.35:8: The prophets who were before me and before you from of old prophesied against many a land and against great kingdoms concerning war;
verses.35:9: as for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word comes to pass, they shall know the prophet whom the Lord has sent to them in faithfulness."
verses.35:10: And Hananiah took the yoke-bars from the neck of Jeremiah in the sight of all the people, and broke them.
verses.35:11: And Hananiah spoke in the sight of all the people, saying, "Thus says the Lord: So will I break the yoke of the king of Babylon from the necks of all the nations." And Jeremiah went on his way.
verses.35:12: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah after Hananiah had broken the yoke-bars from his neck, saying,
verses.35:13: "Go and speak to Hananiah, saying, 'Thus says the Lord: Wooden yoke-bars you have broken, and I will make in their place iron yoke-bars.
verses.35:14: For thus says the Lord: An iron yoke I have placed upon the neck of all the nations, to serve the king of Babylon.'"
verses.35:15: And Jeremiah said to Hananiah, "The Lord has not sent you, and you have caused this people to trust in what is unjust.
verses.35:16: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am sending you away from the face of the earth; this year you shall die."
verses.35:17: And he died in the seventh month.
verses.36:1: Now these are the words of the book which Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the elders of the exile, and to the priests, and to the false prophets—a letter to Babylon for the exiles—and to all the people,
verses.36:2: after King Jeconiah, and the queen, and the eunuchs, and every free man, and prisoner, and craftsman had departed from Jerusalem,
verses.36:3: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Babylon in Babylon, saying:
verses.36:4: "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning the exiles whom I carried away from Jerusalem:
verses.36:5: Build houses and dwell in them, and plant orchards and eat their fruits,
verses.36:6: and take wives and bring forth sons and daughters, and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, and multiply, and do not be diminished,
verses.36:7: and seek the peace of the land into which I carried you away, and pray concerning them to the Lord; for in its peace is your peace.
verses.36:8: For thus says the Lord: Do not let the false prophets who are among you mislead you, and do not let your diviners mislead you, and do not listen to your dreams which you yourselves dream;
verses.36:9: for they prophesy unrighteous things to you in My name, and I did not send them.
verses.36:10: For thus says the Lord: When seventy years are about to be fulfilled for Babylon, I will visit you and establish My words upon you, to bring back your people to this place,
verses.36:11: and I will devise for you a purpose of peace and not evil things, to give these things to you.
verses.36:12: And pray to Me, and I will hear you;
verses.36:13: and seek Me earnestly, and you shall find Me; for you shall seek Me with all your heart,
verses.36:14: and I will appear to you.
verses.36:15: Because you have said, 'The Lord has appointed prophets for us in Babylon,'
verses.36:21: thus says the Lord concerning Ahab and concerning Zedekiah: Behold, I am giving them into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall strike them down before your eyes.
verses.36:22: And they shall take up a curse from them among all the exiles of Judah in Babylon, saying, 'May the Lord do to you as He did to Zedekiah and as He did to Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,'
verses.36:23: because of the lawlessness which they committed in Israel, and they committed adultery with the wives of their fellow citizens, and proclaimed a word in My name which I did not command them; and I am a witness, declares the Lord."
verses.36:24: And to Shemaiah the Elamite you shall say,
verses.36:25: "I did not send you in My name." And to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest say,
verses.36:26: "The Lord has appointed you as priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, to be overseer in the house of the Lord over every man who prophesies and every man who is mad, and you shall put him into confinement and into the dungeon.
verses.36:27: And now why have you reviled Jeremiah of Anathoth, who prophesied to you?
verses.36:28: Did he not on this account send to you in Babylon, saying, 'It is far off; build houses and dwell in them, and plant gardens and you shall eat their fruit'?"
verses.36:29: And Zephaniah read the scroll in the ears of Jeremiah.
verses.36:30: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.36:31: "Send to the exiles, saying, 'Thus says the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Elamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I did not send him, and he has caused you to trust in unrighteous things,
verses.36:32: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will punish Shemaiah and his offspring, and there shall not be a man of theirs in your midst to see the good things which I will do for you; they shall not see them.'"
verses.37:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.37:2: "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, saying: Write all the words which I have declared to you on a scroll.
verses.37:3: For behold, days are coming, declares the Lord, and I will restore the exile of My people Israel and Judah, says the Lord, and I will bring them back to the land which I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it."
verses.37:4: And these are the words which the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah.
verses.37:5: Thus says the Lord: "You shall hear a voice of fear; fear, and there is no peace.
verses.37:6: Ask and see whether a male has given birth, and concerning fear in which they shall hold fast their loins and deliverance; for I have seen every man with his hands upon his loins; faces have turned, it has become jaundice.
verses.37:7: For great is that day, and there is none like it; and it is a time of distress for Jacob,
verses.37:8: yet out of it he shall be saved. In that day, says the Lord, I will shatter the yoke from their neck and tear apart their bonds, and they themselves shall not serve strangers,
verses.37:9: but they shall serve the Lord their God, and I will raise up for them David their king."
verses.37:12: Thus says the Lord: "I have raised up a fracture; painful is your wound,
verses.37:13: there is no one to judge your cause; you have been treated to your pain, there is no benefit for you.
verses.37:14: All your friends have forgotten you; they shall by no means inquire; for with the blow of an enemy I have struck you, with stern discipline; because of all your unrighteousness, your sins have multiplied.
verses.37:16: Therefore all who devour you shall be devoured, and all your enemies shall eat all their own flesh; because of the multitude of your iniquities, your sins have multiplied—they have done these things to you; and those who plunder you shall become plunder, and all who prey upon you I will give for a prey.
verses.37:17: For I will bring up your healing; from a grievous wound I will heal you, declares the Lord; because you were called Scattered—'She is your prey, for there is no one who seeks her.'"
verses.37:18: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will restore the exile of Jacob, and I will have mercy on his captivity; and the city shall be built upon its height, and the people shall dwell according to its judgment.
verses.37:19: And out of them shall go forth singers, the voice of those who make merry; and I will multiply them, and they shall by no means be diminished.
verses.37:20: And their sons shall enter in as before, and their testimonies shall be set upright before My face; and I will punish those who afflict them,
verses.37:21: and those mightier than he shall be over them, and his ruler shall come forth from himself; and I will gather them, and they shall return to Me; for who is this who has set his heart to return to Me, declares the Lord?"
verses.37:23: For the furious wrath of the Lord has gone forth; a whirling wrath has gone forth; upon the ungodly it shall come.
verses.37:24: The fierce wrath of the Lord shall by no means turn back until He has executed, and until He has established the undertaking of His heart; in the latter days you shall know these things.
verses.38:1: "At that time," says the Lord, "I will be God to the family of Israel, and they shall be My people."
verses.38:2: Thus says the Lord: "I found warmth in the wilderness with those who perished by the sword; go, and do not destroy Israel."
verses.38:3: The Lord appeared to him from afar: "With an everlasting love I have loved you; therefore I have drawn you into compassion.
verses.38:4: For I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin Israel; you shall take up your timbrel and go forth with the assembly of those who make merry.
verses.38:5: For you have planted vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; plant and give praise,
verses.38:6: for there is a day of calling by those who make defense on the mountains of Ephraim: 'Arise, and go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.'"
verses.38:7: For thus says the Lord to Jacob: "Rejoice and neigh over the head of the nations; make it heard and give praise; say, 'The Lord has saved His people, the remnant of Israel.'
verses.38:8: Behold, I bring them from the north, and I will gather them from the farthest part of the earth at the feast of Passover; and you shall bear a great multitude, and they shall return here.
verses.38:9: With weeping they went out, and with consolation I will bring them back, causing them to lodge by channels of waters in a straight way, and they shall by no means go astray in it; for I have become a Father to Israel, and Ephraim is My firstborn."
verses.38:10: Hear the words of the Lord, O nations, and declare them to the islands afar off; say, "He who winnowed Israel will gather him, and will keep him as one who tends his flock."
verses.38:11: For the Lord has redeemed Jacob; He has delivered him from the hand of those stronger than he.
verses.38:12: And they shall come and be glad on Mount Zion, and they shall come to the good things of the Lord, to a land of grain and wine and fruits, and of cattle and sheep; and their soul shall be like a fruitful tree, and they shall hunger no more.
verses.38:13: Then the virgins shall rejoice in the assembly of young men, and the aged men shall rejoice; and I will turn their mourning into joy, and I will make them glad.
verses.38:14: I will magnify and abundantly satisfy the soul of the priests, the sons of Levi, and My people shall be filled with My good things.
verses.38:15: Thus says the Lord: "A voice was heard in Ramah, of lamentation and weeping and wailing; Rachel, weeping bitterly, would not cease for her sons, because they are no more."
verses.38:16: Thus says the Lord: "Let your voice cease from weeping, and your eyes from your tears; for there is a reward for your works, and they shall return from the land of the enemies,
verses.38:18: "I have surely heard Ephraim wailing: 'You have disciplined me, and I was disciplined; I, like a calf, was not trained. Turn me back, and I will return, for You are the Lord my God.
verses.38:19: For after my captivity I repented, and after I came to know, I groaned over the days of shame, and I showed You that I received reproach from my youth.'
verses.38:20: Ephraim is a beloved son to Me, a delightful child; for since My words are in him, I will surely remember him. Therefore I have hastened over him; I will surely have mercy on him," says the Lord.
verses.38:21: Set yourself up, O Zion, make retribution, set your heart to the shoulders; return by the way in which you went, O virgin Israel, return to your cities mourning.
verses.38:22: How long will you turn away, O dishonored daughter? For the Lord has created salvation for a new planting; in salvation men shall walk about.
verses.38:23: For thus says the Lord: "Once again they shall speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I bring back its captivity: 'Blessed be the Lord upon His righteous, holy mountain!'
verses.38:24: And there shall be those who dwell in the cities of Judah and in all its land together with the farmer, and he shall be lifted up with a flock.
verses.38:25: For I have abundantly satisfied every thirsty soul, and every hungry soul I have filled."
verses.38:26: Because of this I awoke and looked, and my sleep was sweet to me.
verses.38:27: "Therefore, behold, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will sow Israel and Judah with the seed of man and the seed of beast.
verses.38:28: And it shall come to pass that just as I watched over them to tear down and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," says the Lord.
verses.38:29: In those days they shall by no means say, "The fathers ate unripe grapes, and the teeth of the children were set on edge";
verses.38:30: rather, each one shall die in his own sin, and the one who eats the unripe grapes—his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.38:31: "Behold, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,
verses.38:32: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took hold of their hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not remain in My covenant, and I disregarded them," says the Lord.
verses.38:33: "For this is My covenant that I will make with the house of Israel: After those days," says the Lord, "I will surely put My laws into their mind, and upon their hearts I will write them; and I will be God to them, and they shall be My people.
verses.38:34: And they shall not teach, each one his fellow citizen and each one his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' for all of them shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them; for I will be merciful to their iniquities, and their sins I will remember no more."
verses.38:35: "If heaven is lifted up on high," says the Lord, "and if the foundation of the earth is brought low beneath, still I will not reject the family of Israel," says the Lord, "for all that they have done."
verses.38:36: Thus says the Lord, who gave the sun for the light of the day, the moon and the stars for the light of the night, and a roaring in the sea, and its waves boomed—the Lord Almighty is His name:
verses.38:37: "If these laws cease from before Me," says the Lord, "then the family of Israel shall also cease from being a nation before Me all the days."
verses.38:38: "Behold, days are coming," says the Lord, "when a city shall be built for the Lord from the Tower of Hanameel to the Corner Gate.
verses.38:39: And its measuring line shall go out opposite them as far as the hills of Gareb, and it shall be encompassed round about with choice stones;
verses.38:40: and all the Asaremoth as far as Nahal Kidron, as far as the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, shall be a sanctuary to the Lord; and it shall no longer fail, nor shall it be torn down forever."
